items.title: Senior Director, GTM Analytics at Kaseya
items.summary: About Kaseya Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business suc
items.description: About Kaseya Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we’re still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you’re in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. We’re building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you’re driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you’ll fit right in. At Kaseya, we don’t just raise the bar. We build it. Position Summary Kaseya is seeking a Senior Director, GTM Data Analytics to lead and scale the analytics capabilities that drive go-to-market performance and revenue growth. This strategic leadership role will define the vision, strategy, and operating model for GTM analytics, transforming complex data into actionable insights that inform executive decision-making, improve forecasting, and increase sales productivity. The Senior Director will establish a trusted, integrated analytics framework across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance, ensuring leaders have consistent visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, rep-level performance, and key revenue drivers. This leader will oversee the development of scalable data products, KPI governance, automated reporting, and predictive analytics capabilities, including AI-enabled insights that improve business outcomes. This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for an analytics executive who can combine strategic vision, technical expertise, commercial acumen, and organizational leadership to build a world-class GTM analytics function. The successful candidate will partner closely with executive leadership to translate business priorities into analytical strategies that accelerate decision-making, improve accountability, and support Kaseya’s continued growth. Key Responsibilities GTM Data & Analytics Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year GTM analytics strategy aligned with business priorities and revenue objectives. Establish the operating model, delivery standards, and roadmap for analytical products, ensuring investments are prioritized based on business impact and measurable outcomes. Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Own executive-level GTM performance reporting, scorecards, and analytics used to evaluate pipeline health, bookings, revenue, sales productivity, retention, and expansion. Translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations for executive leadership and board discussions. KPI Development & Data Governance: Establish and maintain consistent, trusted definitions for GTM metrics, including pipeline, bookings, win rates, sales cycles, quota attainment, and rep productivity. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance to align metric definitions, ownership, data quality, and reporting standards. Forecasting & Predictive Analytics: Lead the development and continuous improvement of pipeline, bookings, and revenue forecasting capabilities. Leverage historical trends, leading indicators, and predictive modeling to improve forecast accuracy, identify performance risks, and inform territory planning, capacity decisions, quotas, and resource allocation. Data Integration & Automation: Partner with Data Engineering, IT, and Sales Operations to integrate CRM, marketing automation, customer success, product usage, billing, and financial data into a unified GTM analytics ecosystem. Drive automation of recurring reporting and develop scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical products using shared enterprise platforms. AI-Enabled Insights & Innovation: Identify and implement opportunities to apply artificial intelligence, machine learning, and predictive analytics to GTM performance, including opportunity scoring, churn and expansion risk, forecast automation, and automated insight generation. Executive Partnership & Business Adoption: Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior GTM and functional leaders. Collaborate with stakeholders to define business questions, identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and ensure analytical insights translate into decisions and measurable action. Drive adoption through effective communication, training, documentation, and integration into business operating routines. Organizational Leadership & Development: Build and lead a scalable, multi-layer analytics organization, including managers and senior individual contributors. Establish organizational structures, career paths, and operating practices that support growth while developing future leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable business impact. Budget & Resource Management: Own the GTM analytics budget, evaluate investments in talent and technology, and develop business cases that demonstrate the value of analytics initiatives. Prioritize resources and tooling to maximize efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes. Continuous Improvement & Scalability: Establish standards for analytical solution development, testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement. Reduce manual reporting efforts, improve data reliability, and build reusable analytics capabilities that scale with business growth. Cross-Functional Data Strategy: Partner with enterprise data and technology teams to influence platform priorities, integration strategies, and vendor decisions affecting GTM analytics. Support the integration of data and reporting from acquired businesses into Kaseya’s GTM analytics environment. Required Qualifications 12+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data strategy, reporting, or forecasting, including leadership of analytics functions supporting go-to-market organizations within SaaS or technology businesses. Deep expertise in GTM and revenue analytics, including pipeline management, forecasting, sales performance, rep-level productivity, and revenue-driving metrics. 5+ years of experience leading analytics or business intelligence teams, including managing managers and leading multiple teams or functions. Demonstrated success developing and executing an analytics strategy and building, scaling, or transforming an analytics organization. Proven experience owning executive-level GTM reporting, KPI frameworks, forecasting, and decision-support capabilities within a complex organization. Experience managing an analytics budget, evaluating technology investments, and prioritizing resources based on business impact. Strong technical proficiency with Salesforce, Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform, and modern business intelligence and reporting tools. Experience integrating multiple data sources, developing scalable reporting solutions, and implementing data governance practices that improve data quality, consistency, and automation. Experience applying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled capabilities to business data to improve forecasting, performance insights, or decision-making. Demonstrated ability to influence C-suite executives and senior business leaders, communicate complex analytical findings clearly, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations. Strong organizational leadership, strategic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience in high-growth SaaS, enterprise software, IT management, cybersecurity, or a related technology environment. Experience with Power BI or comparable business intelligence tools, semantic modeling, and enterprise BI governance. Background in revenue analytics, Sales Operations, territory and capacity planning, or enterprise performance management. Experience deploying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled solutions in production environments, including opportunity scoring, churn prediction, or forecast automation. Experience integrating data, systems, and reporting capabilities following acquisitions, particularly within private-equity-backed or high-growth organizations. Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple regions. Demonstrated success building scalable analytics capabilities that improve operational efficiency, sales productivity, and revenue performance. Additional information Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

items.title: Analytics Engineer
items.summary: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.…
items.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role Pleo's Intelligence function covers the full analytical picture - product behaviour, GTM performance, commercial data science, financial reporting, and operational intelligence. The Analytics Engineers who serve these teams own the data modelling layer that all of it runs on: dbt models, metric definitions, and semantic layer contributions that analysts, product teams, and AI tools depend on to get consistent, trustworthy answers. You'll be embedded in the Product Intelligence team, building the tracking, experimentation, and data modelling foundations that make product data trustworthy and self-serve. You'll join a close-knit team actively migrating our analytics stack onto a new Analytics Warehouse and Omni, moving off legacy tools like Looker and Hippocampus. If you want to build the infrastructure that other people's product decisions run on rather than just report on what exists, this is the opportunity for you. Who you'll work with and reporting to You will report to an Analytics Manager leading Product Intelligence and Growth Intelligence. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Product Analysts, and Engineering to get tracking, experimentation, and metric definitions right from the ground up. You'll also engage with the broader Analytics Engineering community across Pleo to drive shared standards, especially around the semantic layer that keeps metrics consistent across the organization. What you'll be doing Build and maintain dbt models in our new Analytics Warehouse, using a clean, layered architecture and migrating logic off legacy tools as you go. Own tracking plan implementation and QA directly in Segment and Amplitude in close partnership with Product and Engineering. Support experimentation by modelling assignment and outcome data into structured formats that analysts and PMs can query directly. Define and document metrics in our semantic layer, ensuring a single authoritative definition so downstream BI tools and AI applications yield consistent answers. Apply AI-augmented data modelling practices as a standard part of how you write, review, and migrate code. Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to turn one-off questions into durable, reusable data models. Maintain data quality in your domain through dbt tests, freshness SLAs, and proactive monitoring. What you bring Solid SQL and dbt experience, with a clear comfort owning models end to end. Working knowledge of event-based tracking tools like Segment or Amplitude. Experience with Git-based development workflows, including opening and reviewing pull requests. Clear communication skills to explain data definitions and structures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Genuine day-to-day use of AI tooling as part of your standard coding and workflow routine. Comfort navigating ambiguity and untangling legacy logic to build modern foundations. This role is NOT a good fit if You only want to write dashboards without touching or owning the underlying data models. You require rigid processes and heavy upfront structure before taking initiative. You prefer to avoid data migration, cleanup work, and legacy system refactoring. Your first 6 months Ramp up: Master our dbt project structure, tracking plans, and migration roadmap while shipping small, reviewed code changes early on. Take ownership: Own a dedicated slice of the migration, such as an event domain or our core experimentation data models. Drive consistency: Establish semantic layer definitions for your domain so analysts and PMs can self-serve accurate metrics without custom workarounds. Our tech stack context Data warehouse: GCP / BigQuery (new Analytics Warehouse) Transformation: dbt Orchestration: Airflow Tracking and Oroduct Analytics: Segment, Amplitude BI and Analytics: Omni (migrating off legacy Looker and Hippocampus) Languages: SQL Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days—enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office. Comprehensive private healthcare depending on your location (coverage options include Vitality, Alan, or Médis). 25 days of annual holiday plus public holidays, with the option to purchase 5 additional days through salary sacrifice. Flexible working options supporting both hybrid and fully remote setups. Free mental health and well-being support through MyndUp. Generous paid parental leave policies to support growing families. The interview process Intro Call: 30 minutes with our Talent Partner SQL Test: Completed via CoderPad Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes with our Data & Analytics Manager Team Interview & Live Case: Data modelling case via CodeSignal Final Interview: 30 minutes with our VP of Data & AI Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired an Analytics Engineer, we received a total of 173 applications but only 10 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: it was very clear that many of the CVs we saw were very generic and AI generated. There is no issue with leveraging AI to help with CV writing, there was little indication of what real impact the candidates had in their previous experience. You might have heard of the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit Laszlo Bock ~2014), this is a great way to give a clear picture of what you have actually worked on. Some link or quick description of the companies you’ve worked with is also a great help. Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: there was misunderstanding about the type of experience we expect from an Analytics Engineer and we received many applications from candidates who had never been exposed to a product-led environment or had been exclusively focused on SQL/dbt work when we’re looking for both technical and stakeholders management and team collaboration experience. To be perfectly clear, this is NOT a Data Engineer role or a Data Analyst role! This is a heavily-driven dbt modelling role, experience in this area is critical. We’ve taken great care in writing this role description to reflect the reality of the job as best as possible, please ensure you read it carefully and highlight on your CV the experience relevant to what we are looking for. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

items.summary: Who We Are: Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes. For more than a decade, we have built our business aro
items.description: Who We Are: Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes. For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another. At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today. ***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role. A day in the life: You’ll sit on the fusepoint Marketing Science Team and own the data behind Power Digital’s measurement products: Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and incrementality testing (Matched Market Testing, MMT). Our measurement tools are used by internal and external teams to read model results, plan budgets, pick test markets and report on incrementality tests. Your job is to make sure the data needed for measurement analysis is clean, reconciled and ready for modeling, so the analysts and data scientists spend their time on modeling, not cleanup. You’ll work closely with the Data Team to support, maintain, and engineer data sources related to measurement and marketing metrics. Key Responsibilities: Own the MMM data layer in Snowflake. Build and maintain model-ready daily and weekly marts for each client that combine paid media (spend, impressions, clicks by channel and campaign), ecommerce revenue and orders (new vs. returning, gross and net, refunds, discounts), site and email/SMS data from GA4, and any non-media drivers. Every mart has consistent channel groupings, currencies and timezones. Own the MMT geo data layer. Build geo-level media and sales tables at DMA (or Comscore), state and zip level for every major platform (Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest, Amazon, Microsoft, Programmatic, etc.) and for CMS/CRM/Amazon/Retail Datsets, with standard market names that line up across sources. These tables feed automated market selection, pre-period validation, synthetic control models and test readouts. Build and automate a data quality process . Turn the checks we currently run manually into automated Snowflake/dbt tests and alerts: date gaps, zero-spend or zero-revenue days, cost without impressions (and the reverse), duplicated or unmatched markets, outlier spikes, restatement drift and source freshness. Problems should be flagged before a model is trained or a test is read out. Own and maintain model logs and exported model outputs (contributions, response curves, adstock, optimization results) well structured, versioned and easy to query. Support onboarding of new measurement clients. Own and maintain a repeatable, mostly automated process: map their data feeds, check history depth and quality, and flag gaps before modeling starts. Handle client-specific data needs as they come up. You are not responsible for client workflow, but you may need to jump in to assist the team as things come up.. Write client-specific overrides, channel mappings and marts when a client needs them, and decide whether each piece of logic belongs in the shared core or in the client’s own layer. Use AI coding tools to work faster (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Hex’s AI agent), and document the patterns that work so the team adopts them. Role Requirements: 3+ years in data or analytics engineering, including 1+ year owning a production dbt project of meaningful size. Advanced SQL and Python, with production-grade pipeline code. Deep dbt expertise: incremental models vs. full refreshes, Jinja and macros, tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and keeping a large DAG under control. Strong Snowflake skills: semi-structured/VARIANT data, dynamic per-client queries, query and cost tuning, permissions across separate client databases. Hands-on marketing and ecommerce data experience: ad-platform APIs, UTMs, attribution windows, platform-reported vs. warehouse-reported conversions, Shopify order and refund logic. An understanding of what measurement models need from data: a continuous time series, consistent granularity, stable channel definitions, enough history, and the reasons one bad week or market can skew results. Experience building multi-client data models, with the judgment to know when logic belongs in the shared core and when it belongs in a client layer. Git and CI/CD with automated testing you trust. Real adoption of AI-assisted development workflows. Comfort shipping iteratively based on feedback from analysts and app users. Helpful but not required Direct MMM or incrementality experience (Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing, synthetic control/causal impact, geo-lift). Experience with geographic data: DMA/zip mappings, population and market-size data. Hex experience (SQL/Python notebooks, semantic models, published apps), or similar BI/notebook tools. Experience at an agency, consultancy or martech company. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) MMT coverage: Geo-level MMT tables for all data sources are created and in use by the Measurement team in the first 3 months of the role Measurement-ready data: Within 6 months, ≥95% of active MMM and MMT clients have automated, tested Snowflake marts feeding Hex, with no client-specific cleaning logic left in app notebooks for core sources. Data quality: ≥99% completeness and accuracy on critical measurement fields. Zero model refreshes or test readouts delivered with an undetected date gap, duplicated market or unreconciled revenue source. Reliability: ≥95% success rate for scheduled measurement pipelines, excluding documented vendor outages. Speed and efficiency: Cut new-client measurement onboarding time (data mapping and validation) by 30% within 12 months. Measurably reduce load and refresh times for the main Hex measurement apps. Client requests: Deliver ≥90% of client-specific measurement data requests within the agreed turnaround AI-assisted development: At least 1 reusable AI-assisted development pattern documented within 120 days and 2 within 12 months, each used in at least 2 production workflows. Most Important Things (MITs) Deliver clean, model-ready MMM and MMT data in Snowflake so the measurement team’s data can be trusted without extra cleanup. Build a process to catch data issues before they reach a model or test readout. Build a single, documented measurement data foundation that grows with the client list and is ready for AI use. Benefits & Perks: Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities Unlimited Time Off available on day one Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid Offices in Buenos Aires, Medellin, San Diego, New York, Atlanta Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s) Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone’s responsibility. Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at recruiting@powerdigital.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

items.description: Who We Are: Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes. For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another. At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today. ***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role. A day in the life: You’ll sit on the fusepoint Marketing Science Team and own the data behind Power Digital’s measurement products: Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and incrementality testing (Matched Market Testing, MMT). Our measurement tools are used by internal and external teams to read model results, plan budgets, pick test markets and report on incrementality tests. Your job is to make sure the data needed for measurement analysis is clean, reconciled and ready for modeling, so the analysts and data scientists spend their time on modeling, not cleanup. You’ll work closely with the Data Team to support, maintain, and engineer data sources related to measurement and marketing metrics. Key Responsibilities: Own the MMM data layer in Snowflake. Build and maintain model-ready daily and weekly marts for each client that combine paid media (spend, impressions, clicks by channel and campaign), ecommerce revenue and orders (new vs. returning, gross and net, refunds, discounts), site and email/SMS data from GA4, and any non-media drivers. Every mart has consistent channel groupings, currencies and timezones. Own the MMT geo data layer. Build geo-level media and sales tables at DMA (or Comscore), state and zip level for every major platform (Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest, Amazon, Microsoft, Programmatic, etc.) and for CMS/CRM/Amazon/Retail Datsets, with standard market names that line up across sources. These tables feed automated market selection, pre-period validation, synthetic control models and test readouts. Build and automate a data quality process . Turn the checks we currently run manually into automated Snowflake/dbt tests and alerts: date gaps, zero-spend or zero-revenue days, cost without impressions (and the reverse), duplicated or unmatched markets, outlier spikes, restatement drift and source freshness. Problems should be flagged before a model is trained or a test is read out. Own and maintain model logs and exported model outputs (contributions, response curves, adstock, optimization results) well structured, versioned and easy to query. Support onboarding of new measurement clients. Own and maintain a repeatable, mostly automated process: map their data feeds, check history depth and quality, and flag gaps before modeling starts. Handle client-specific data needs as they come up. You are not responsible for client workflow, but you may need to jump in to assist the team as things come up.. Write client-specific overrides, channel mappings and marts when a client needs them, and decide whether each piece of logic belongs in the shared core or in the client’s own layer. Use AI coding tools to work faster (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Hex’s AI agent), and document the patterns that work so the team adopts them. Role Requirements: 3+ years in data or analytics engineering, including 1+ year owning a production dbt project of meaningful size. Advanced SQL and Python, with production-grade pipeline code. Deep dbt expertise: incremental models vs. full refreshes, Jinja and macros, tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and keeping a large DAG under control. Strong Snowflake skills: semi-structured/VARIANT data, dynamic per-client queries, query and cost tuning, permissions across separate client databases. Hands-on marketing and ecommerce data experience: ad-platform APIs, UTMs, attribution windows, platform-reported vs. warehouse-reported conversions, Shopify order and refund logic. An understanding of what measurement models need from data: a continuous time series, consistent granularity, stable channel definitions, enough history, and the reasons one bad week or market can skew results. Experience building multi-client data models, with the judgment to know when logic belongs in the shared core and when it belongs in a client layer. Git and CI/CD with automated testing you trust. Real adoption of AI-assisted development workflows. Comfort shipping iteratively based on feedback from analysts and app users. Helpful but not required Direct MMM or incrementality experience (Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing, synthetic control/causal impact, geo-lift). Experience with geographic data: DMA/zip mappings, population and market-size data. Hex experience (SQL/Python notebooks, semantic models, published apps), or similar BI/notebook tools. Experience at an agency, consultancy or martech company. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) MMT coverage: Geo-level MMT tables for all data sources are created and in use by the Measurement team in the first 3 months of the role Measurement-ready data: Within 6 months, ≥95% of active MMM and MMT clients have automated, tested Snowflake marts feeding Hex, with no client-specific cleaning logic left in app notebooks for core sources. Data quality: ≥99% completeness and accuracy on critical measurement fields. Zero model refreshes or test readouts delivered with an undetected date gap, duplicated market or unreconciled revenue source. Reliability: ≥95% success rate for scheduled measurement pipelines, excluding documented vendor outages. Speed and efficiency: Cut new-client measurement onboarding time (data mapping and validation) by 30% within 12 months. Measurably reduce load and refresh times for the main Hex measurement apps. Client requests: Deliver ≥90% of client-specific measurement data requests within the agreed turnaround AI-assisted development: At least 1 reusable AI-assisted development pattern documented within 120 days and 2 within 12 months, each used in at least 2 production workflows. Most Important Things (MITs) Deliver clean, model-ready MMM and MMT data in Snowflake so the measurement team’s data can be trusted without extra cleanup. Build a process to catch data issues before they reach a model or test readout. Build a single, documented measurement data foundation that grows with the client list and is ready for AI use. Benefits & Perks: Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities Unlimited Time Off available on day one Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid Offices in Buenos Aires, Medellin, San Diego, New York, Atlanta Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s) Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity We’re looking for a Senior DataOps Engineer to help operate, scale, and improve the data platforms that support Oportun’s analytics, engineering, and business teams. This role will focus on Databricks, AWS, data pipelines, databases, observability, automation, and production support. You’ll be responsible for keeping critical data-platform services reliable, secure, performant, and cost-effective while partnering closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Cloud Infrastructure, Database, and application teams. Success in this role means improving platform reliability, reducing operational friction, strengthening automation, and helping teams resolve issues quickly and sustainably. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll administer and support Databricks workspaces, cluster policies, compute configurations, jobs, workflows, libraries, service principals, permissions, and platform integrations. You’ll support Unity Catalog, including access governance, catalog and schema permissions, and secure data sharing. You’ll monitor and troubleshoot Delta Live Tables, Spark jobs, Delta Lake workloads, and data pipelines, including failures, performance issues, recovery, and data-quality concerns. You’ll maintain secure and reliable integrations between Databricks and AWS services, including S3, IAM, networking, VPC connectivity, and external data sources. You’ll support AWS infrastructure used by the data platform, including EC2, VPC, IAM, security groups, networking, patching, and operational access. You’ll support MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB environments, including availability, monitoring, connectivity, backup coordination, performance troubleshooting, and recovery. You’ll build and maintain monitoring, dashboards, logs, metrics, and alerts across Databricks, pipelines, databases, infrastructure, and integrations. You’ll participate in on-call support and lead investigation, mitigation, recovery, communication, and root-cause analysis for production incidents. You’ll build and maintain infrastructure and automation using Terraform, Terraform Enterprise, Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting. You’ll automate repeatable operational activities such as provisioning, access configuration, monitoring deployment, recovery, and platform changes. You’ll manage secure access controls, secrets, certificates, TLS configuration, service accounts, and IAM roles across platform services. You’ll improve operational readiness through runbooks, recovery procedures, architecture diagrams, standards, escalation paths, and technical documentation. You’ll partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to improve capacity planning, platform performance, cost visibility, and resource optimization. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI and automation to improve troubleshooting, documentation, incident response, and operational efficiency. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on platform engineer who enjoys solving complex production problems and improving the systems behind critical data workloads. You think beyond the immediate issue, look for root causes, and build solutions that make the platform more reliable and easier to operate. You’re comfortable working across cloud infrastructure, data platforms, databases, automation, and security. You communicate clearly during incidents, take ownership through resolution, and consistently look for ways to reduce repetitive work and improve operational maturity. What You Bring Skills & experience Required Strong experience supporting production data platforms, cloud infrastructure, or DataOps environments. Hands-on experience administering and supporting Databricks, including workspaces, jobs, workflows, compute, cluster policies, and access controls. Experience supporting Spark, Delta Lake, and Delta Live Tables workloads. Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, security groups, CloudWatch, and networking. Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Terraform Enterprise or similar tools. Experience supporting MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB in production environments. Strong understanding of monitoring, observability, alerting, and incident-management practices. Experience with CI/CD, Git, GitHub Actions, and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages. Experience troubleshooting platform performance, connectivity, permissions, certificates, TLS, and integration issues. Experience with production support, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and on-call operations. Strong understanding of security and access concepts such as IAM, RBAC, secrets management, certificates, and secure connectivity. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Infrastructure, Database, and application teams. Nice to Have Experience with Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Databricks CLI, REST APIs, and Databricks asset or deployment bundles. Experience with Kubernetes administration and production troubleshooting. Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms. Experience with Rootly or similar incident-management platforms. Experience with MongoDB Atlas, Ops Manager, or comparable MongoDB tooling. Experience with MariaDB/MySQL replication, schema migrations, indexing, backup validation, and restore procedures. Experience with capacity planning, cloud cost optimization, and workload performance tuning. Experience implementing or improving data governance, compliance controls, or audit processes. Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve operations, troubleshooting, documentation, or automation. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund Life Insurance Internet and Electricity Allowance Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-sr-dataops-engineer-r14334

items.description: About the Role We're looking for an Operations Specialist to help transform how we scale and deliver talent for high-growth AI projects. You'll join our team within Expert Operations (XOps), working to simplify complex workflows, eliminate repetitive tasks, and build AI-powered automations that help us meet contributor demand efficiently and at scale. This is a hands-on role with a high degree of ownership, ideal for someone who enjoys solving operational challenges, experimenting with AI tools, and turning manual processes into smarter, more scalable systems. Location & Work Authorization Requirements This is a remote position open exclusively to candidates currently based in Argentina, Brazil, or Mexico. Applicants must reside in one of these three countries and have valid legal authorization to work in their country of residence. Both requirements are mandatory to be considered for this role. Your Impact Map and analyse end-to-end fulfillment workflows, from project headcount requests through contributor activation, to identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. Design, build, and maintain AI agents, automated workflows, and internal tools that streamline recruiting and fulfillment operations. Leverage AI-assisted sourcing tools to build targeted contributor pipelines efficiently and at scale. Automate repetitive sourcing activities, including talent targeting, profile identification, and skills mapping. Develop and maintain automated dashboards and reports to track recruitment funnels, conversion rates, and fulfillment progress. Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and productivity. Document workflows, establish best practices, and support team members in adopting new tools and processes. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and continuously improve operational performance. Success in this role means building reliable, scalable automations that reduce manual work, improve operational efficiency, and enable our Fulfillment team to meet growing project demands. What You Bring 2+ years of experience in operations, process improvement, data analysis, automation, or a related field, ideally within AI, technology, marketplace, or high-growth environments. Demonstrated experience identifying inefficiencies, improving business processes, and transforming manual workflows into scalable solutions. Strong hands-on experience using AI models and tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, or similar platforms to build practical workflows or AI agents. Experience integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools into automation workflows. Strong analytical and data management skills, including proficiency in Excel. Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and solve problems in fast-changing environments. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to document processes and support the adoption of new technologies. Curiosity, adaptability, and enthusiasm for exploring emerging AI technologies and applying them to real operational challenges. Nice to Haves Experience with automation platforms or scripting tools such as Python, Google Apps Script, Zapier, Make, or similar. Experience working with APIs, complex JSON data structures, Git, or version control. Knowledge of SQL and data visualization or reporting tools. Experience developing, deploying, or maintaining autonomous AI agents or agentic workflows. Familiarity with AI-powered sourcing, recruitment operations, contributor management, or talent acquisition tools. Experience supporting large-scale, global operations or cross-functional teams. items.description: We are looking for a Risk Data Analyst . The Integrated Risk Management team is managing risk profile of the company. Identifying financial risks and management advisory on their mitigation. Providing service of developing forecasting and risk models for the Company's financial portfolio and implementation in the Company's processes. Challenges that await you : Take ownership of credit risk management as a key domain, oversee the management of credit, liquidity, FX, and strategic (business plan) risks, acting as the 2nd line of defense in the organization’s risk management structure Accurately calculate the unit economics of credit products, with a deep understanding of credit risk drivers, to deliver essential insights for strategic decision-making Develop, implement, and automate a comprehensive risk management framework, integrating it effectively into organizational documents and processes Analyze the methodology of Mexican (CNBV, Banxico) and global (Basel, IFRS) frameworks to apply best practices to PLATA’s processes Evaluate internal and external data to identify potential threats to the PLATA loan portfolio, construct econometric models to predict portfolio dynamics, and detect unusual behavior Create effective data visualizations and presentations to communicate findings and drive necessary actions among managers What makes you a great fit : A minimum of 3 years’ experience in risk and data analysis, preferably within credit organizations or consulting; experience in integrated risk management is a plus Bachelor’s degree in STEM, finance, or economics; a Master’s degree is highly advantageous Exceptional analytical and quantitative abilities, with expertise in statistical analysis, data modeling, and extracting insights from complex data sets Proficiency in SQL and Python (/R) is essential, complemented by knowledge of Tableau (/Apache Superset) and Excel A self-starter with the capability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced, evolving environment Outstanding presentation and communication skills, adept at conveying intricate data concepts to non-technical audiences B1 or higher English level for effective communication with an international team Our ways of working : Innovative Spirit : a commitment to creativity and groundbreaking solutions Honest Feedback: valuing open, transparent communication Supportive Team: a strong, collaborative community Celebrating Achievements: recognizing our wins together High-Tech Environment: a team full of smart and revolutionary people who date to challenge the status quo of incumbent finances Our benefits : Relocation support to one of our hubs — Mexico, Cyprus, Spain, Serbia — with assistance for the employee and their family Flexible work from one of our offices or remote Healthcare Coverage Education Budget: Language lessons, professional training and certifications Wellness Budget: Mental health and fitness activity reimbursements Vacation policy: 20 days of annual leave and paid sick leave Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: About the Role We're looking for a FinOps Data Engineer to help drive cost optimization and cloud financial governance across our AWS infrastructure and GCP footprint. You'll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, and Product to find and ship savings, build the tooling necessary to maximize efficiency of every dollar spent in the cloud, and cultivate…
items.description: About the Role We're looking for a FinOps Data Engineer to help drive cost optimization and cloud financial governance across our AWS infrastructure and GCP footprint. You'll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, and Product to find and ship savings, build the tooling necessary to maximize efficiency of every dollar spent in the cloud, and cultivate a culture of cost awareness across engineering teams. This role owns the data side of that mission: the models, pipelines, and analysis that make cost, usage, and margin numbers trustworthy across the company. This is a hands-on engineering role, not an analyst seat. You'll do the schlep work other teams don't have time for, digging into a bucket's access pattern, writing the dbt model or Python pipeline that ships the fix, building the cost-vs-revenue mart that answers a margin question once instead of every time, and chasing a number until it reconciles. Strong communication matters as much as technical depth, you'll regularly explain a savings case or a data model's implications to an engineering team, a finance stakeholder, and a leadership audience in the same week. What You'll Be Responsible For In this role, you'll: Find and ship savings across AWS and GCP: Analyze billing, usage, and cost trends to identify opportunities, rightsizing, storage lifecycle policies, data transfer, and spot/auto-scaling. Take ideas from identification through to a realized dollar figure, not just a recommendation. Build and maintain the FinOps data pipeline: Design and run the BigQuery/dbt models that turn raw billing and usage data (CUR, Storage Lens) into reconciled, trustworthy mart tables, the foundation everything else in FinOps is built on. Build cost-vs-revenue and customer segmentation models: Model unit economics and margin by product line and customer segment, and extend coverage as new products and segments come online. Apply data science to cost and usage data: Build forecasting models, detect anomalies statistically rather than by threshold alone, and quantify savings opportunities (e.g. storage lifecycle, request-cost patterns) with rigor a spreadsheet can't match. Build and maintain cost attribution: Tagging policies, cost allocation, and chargeback/showback so engineering teams can see and own their own spend. This is foundational work other savings work depends on. Automate cost governance: Build automated cost reporting, anomaly detection, and alerting. Write the scripts and infrastructure-as-code (Python, Terraform, Lambda) that enforce cost policy rather than relying on manual review. Partner with engineering on architecture decisions: Bring cost into the room early, cost-efficiencies are cheaper to get right at design than to retrofit. Work with Finance on forecasting and reporting: Support budget tracking and financial KPIs; build dashboards and self-serve analytics engineering and finance can both read. You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have strong AWS expertise and working GCP knowledge, including pricing models, billing structures, and cost optimization mechanics. Have data engineering depth: dbt, BigQuery (or an equivalent modern warehouse), SQL at scale, and data modeling for analytics (dimensional modeling, incremental models, testing). Have data science fundamentals: statistical forecasting, anomaly detection, and experimentation, and know when a rigorous model beats a rule of thumb. Have automation and scripting skills: Python, Terraform/ pulumi, Lambda, or Bash. Are comfortable with cost/billing tooling: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost & Usage Reports, GCP Billing Reports, and BI/dashboarding (we use Hex). Have experience with, or are comfortable picking up, Linear and Notion as the system of record for tracking and documenting FinOps work. Experience with a dedicated cloud cost management platform (e.g. CloudZero, Vantage, or similar) is a plus, not required. Can analyze cost data and present it clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Have prior experience spanning data analytics, data engineering, or data science in a FinOps, cloud cost management, or cloud governance context. Are energized by doing the unglamorous, high-leverage work (the schlep) that unblocks other teams, and by working cross-functionally without positional authority. What We Offer Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. About the Team Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. ~400 team members 60+ countries 20+ languages spoken Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.) **This is a contract role expected to last until April 15th, 2027 Location : This role is Remote in the U.S., with the option to work onsite from our San Francisco, CA headquarters. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. About Doximity Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role As a Business Intelligence Analyst , you will: Work closely with our Product, Strategic Analytics, Client Success, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses. Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates. Continue to improve your technical and non-technical skill sets. Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform. Grow into a presentation/communication-focused role or dive deeper into more-involved technical challenges—the choice is yours. What We're Looking For We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications: Must have: Three (3) years of experience illustrating collaboration, passion for data, reliability, precision, curiosity, and respect for teammates and clients. Excellent SQL skills with proven ability to create and evaluate complex SQL statements involving numerous tables and complex relationships. Fluent in Python and experience using common modules (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib) for EDA. Experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: Working knowledge of statistics and visualization. Experience working with data visualization tools. Advanced Excel skills. Experience using AI coding assistants and building AI-leveraged workflows. Experience working in the healthcare industry. Experience presenting data to a non-technical audience. The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team. Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights. Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success. Precision – Our team's deliverables power client analysis and inform real-world decisions. A successful candidate will triple check their work and their teammates' work, holding all of us to the highest data quality standards. Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight. Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals. Why You'll Love Working Here At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work. Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care. Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning. Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work. Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development. Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated. Our Hiring Process & AI Tools Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws. Equal Employment Opportunity Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-business-intelligence-analyst-contractor

items.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer NDA
items.summary: GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. Â GTâs mission is to connect the worldâs best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands. On behalf of the client, GT is looking for a Senior Agentic AI Engineer who is interested in solving complex matching and search problems at scale, applying ML and algorithms to hundreds of millions of real-world data records. Â About the Client Our client is a leading global management consultancy known for tackling some of the worldâs most complex business challenges. With a focus on strategy, transformation, and performance improvement, the firm partners with major organizations across industries to drive lasting impact. Recognized consistently as a top workplace, it combines deep industry expertise with a collaborative, innovative culture. Its centralized European hub plays a key role in supporting operations across the EMEA region, ensuring excellence and efficiency at scale. Â About the Project & Role We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help design, build, and evolve an AI-powered conversational analytics platform that enables businesses to explore their data, generate insights and visualizations, and make data-driven decisions. The product helps users analyze promotional performance, answer complex analytical questions, build charts and tables, and generate evidence-based recommendations using LLMs, agentic workflows, and governed client data. The team is developing a scalable, secure, and extensible agentic AI framework that can be customized for different clients and integrated with other products through standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). The existing solution is built on LangChain, with plans to evolve and migrate the framework. This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant architecture and system design component. You will work across the entire agentic AI lifecycle, from designing agent workflows, tools, and integrations to implementing evaluation frameworks, improving reliability, and delivering production-ready AI features. Responsibilities Design, build, and evolve agentic AI workflows for data exploration, analysis, and conversational insights. Develop and improve an extensible agentic framework , including orchestration, reusable tools, skills, and conversation management. Build secure integrations with application services and governed data sources, including sandboxed code execution and AI-powered data visualizations. Design configurable solutions supporting client-specific prompts, tools, skills, and data definitions without duplicating the core architecture. Develop MCP servers and clients to enable communication and data exchange between agents and applications. Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution and migration of the existing LangChain-based solution . Implement LLM evaluation, testing, observability, and security controls to ensure accurate, reliable, and data-grounded AI outputs. Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation to production release and continuous improvement, collaborating with cross-functional teams. Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience Core Requirements 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or related fields, including 2+ years in agentic AI engineering . Strong Python development skills, with experience building, testing, and maintaining production-grade applications. Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, LangChain, or OpenAI Agents SDK. Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and multi-agent or cross-application integrations. Experience developing AI agents for data analysis, including dataset exploration, code generation and execution, and result interpretation. Strong system design and architecture skills, including building configurable, extensible solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs. Understanding of AI security, evaluation, and observability, including secure data access, LLM testing, tracing, and performance monitoring. Strong ownership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with practical experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar). Strongly Preferred Experience with Pydantic AI / Pydantic AI Harness and LangChain , particularly migration between frameworks. Familiarity with SQL, pandas, DuckDB, or Ibis for data analysis. Experience with Azure OpenAI, Docker, and analytical visualization tools such as Plotly or Dash. Nice-to-Have Experience with retail, pricing, promotions analytics, or similar domains. Experience delivering client-facing AI products from prototype to production. Familiarity with React and FastAPI. Interview Process Interview with GT Recruiter Cultural Fit Interview Technical Interview Final Interview Offer Why Join Our Client? Join a globally recognized consulting firm building innovative AI-powered products that solve real business problems. Help shape the architecture and technical direction of an evolving agentic AI platform . Build production AI solutions where accuracy, data security, and reliability are essential. Work with modern AI technologies and development tools, including Pydantic AI, MCP, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex . Collaborate with experienced engineers and product teams in an environment that encourages experimentation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership. Please mention the word **UNCOMPLICATED** and tag RMjMuOTguMTQwLjg0 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjMuOTguMTQwLjg0). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Salary: PHP 80,000 to PHP 120,000/monthly Working Hours & Conditions: Sydney, AU Business Hours and Holidays Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is an integrated property and place marketing agency combining brand strategy, high-end creative, and performance-driven lead generation. Our client portfolio primarily consists of leading Australian property developers marketing off-the-plan residential communities, completed luxury stock, and premium commercial assets. We believe true marketing effectiveness requires total alignment across creative narrative, digital targeting, technical attribution, and sales enablement. ROLE OVERVIEW: We are seeking an autonomous, hands-on Senior Performance Marketing Manager to take full operational ownership of paid advertising across our client roster. In this role, you will steer paid media strategy and day-to-day execution across Meta Ads and Google Search, scaling an account base expected to expand to approximately seven multi-channel client accounts in early 2027. Operating alongside our senior strategy, video, and design directors, you will look beyond basic surface metrics to optimize the entire acquisition funnel. Your core mandate is turning paid traffic into qualified buyer enquiries, booked display suite appointments, and closed developer sales. RESPONSIBILITIES: Paid Media Execution & Management: Architect, launch, and optimize high-converting Meta Ads and Google Search campaigns. Manage budget pacing, audience segmentation, bid strategies, search queries, and negative keyword lists. Maintain meticulous account hygiene, access controls, billing protocols, naming conventions, and policy compliance. Creative Strategy & Iterative Testing: Translate high-level project personas, narrative angles, and visual hooks into rigorous creative testing frameworks. Set minimum spend thresholds, monitor fatigue indicators, and deliver structured briefs to internal design and video teams for iterations, variations, and net-new creative concepts. Tracking, Attribution & Offline Data: Set up, audit, and troubleshoot tracking architecture via GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Pixel, and Conversions API (CAPI). Integrate CRM data pipelines to enable closed-loop offline conversion tracking. Data Visualization & Client Reporting: Build and manage Looker Studio dashboards demonstrating true acquisition ROI, downstream appointment volume, and sales conversion rates. Deliver structured weekly written updates detailing performance drivers, strategic shifts, and upcoming optimizations. Conversion Rate Optimization & Funnel Operations: Audit full user journeys from click to qualification, proposing ongoing landing page enhancements. Execute technical SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) initiatives in coordination with senior leadership, including site speed fixes and email nurture workflows. AI Workflow Integration: Leverage AI tools across daily operations, data analysis, reporting synthesis, and rapid creative ideation. Develop and document standard operating procedures that leverage AI to increase throughput without compromising quality or strategic rigor. Agency & Account Scale: Minimum of 5 years of direct, hands-on performance marketing experience, with a proven track record managing multi-client portfolios within an agency setting. Channel Mastery: Deep, current technical proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search). Downstream Conversion Focus: Demonstrated history driving high-intent B2C or high-consideration lead generation, measuring success by sales outcomes rather than raw lead volume. Technical Infrastructure: Hands-on experience configuring GA4, GTM, Meta CAPI, offline conversion feeds, and custom Looker Studio dashboards. Attribution Acumen: Solid understanding of multi-touch attribution, channel mix modeling constraints, and cross-platform reporting discrepancies. AI Fluency: Active, daily integration of AI workflows into campaign development, copy iteration, or analytical operations. Communication & Cadence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce executive-ready client summaries and precise creative briefs. Operational Alignment: Full availability to work aligned with Sydney, Australia (AEST/AEDT) business hours. Preferred Conversion Optimization: Practical expertise in landing page design principles, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and site speed auditing. Modern Search: Exposure to technical SEO execution and AI search optimization (AEO/GEO). Vertical Experience: Prior exposure to Australian real estate, specifically residential off-the-plan project marketing. Lifecycle Marketing: Hands-on automation experience configuring email qualification funnels in platforms such as Zoho or Brevo. What You’ll Bring Full-Funnel Ownership: A commercial mindset that views media spend as an investment engine tied directly to pipeline appointments and revenue. Analytical Independence: The confidence to diagnose sudden performance shifts, troubleshoot faulty tracking scripts, and proactively bring solutions rather than problems. Creative Curiosity: The ability to decipher why specific visual hooks work, bridging data analysis with sharp creative direction. Process Rigor: Strong personal project management, high attention to operational detail, and the discipline to maintain structured experiments across dynamic accounts. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-senior-performance-marketing-manager-dayshift-remote
