items.title: Data Science Manager
items.summary: We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint…
items.description: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ 📍London or UK remote | 💰 £100,000 to £130,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology - Data ⭐ About Data at Monzo Data is at the heart of how we make decisions and build products at Monzo. Our Data teams bring together Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Analytics and Machine Learning, working closely with Product, Engineering and other teams across the business. Our Data Scientists are embedded within product and business areas across Monzo, where they use experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning and analytics to understand our customers, identify opportunities and influence the direction of our products and strategy. As a Data Science Manager , you'll lead a team of Data Scientists and other Data professionals within one of these areas, combining people leadership with strategic data leadership and close partnership with senior stakeholders. 🔑 You'll play a key role by... You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and senior leaders to ensure data plays a central role in how we understand problems, make decisions and develop our products. You'll lead and develop a team of talented Data Scientists, helping them do their best work while setting a high bar for analytical quality and impact. You'll provide strategic direction across complex problems, help teams identify where Data Science can have the greatest impact, and ensure insights translate into meaningful decisions and product changes. We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across Monzo. We're big believers in powerful, accessible analytics and empowering teams across the business to answer questions themselves. Around 90% of our day-to-day data-driven decisions are supported by self-serve analytics through Looker, giving our Data teams the space to focus on higher-impact problems. Your day-to-day Lead, develop and grow a team of exceptional Data Scientists and other Data professionals. Hire, coach and retain talented people while creating an environment where they can develop and do their best work. Set the Data Science direction for your area and identify where data can have the greatest customer and business impact. Partner with Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders to shape strategy and influence product direction. Bring analytical rigour to complex and ambiguous problems and help teams turn them into clear, actionable opportunities. Ensure teams are using the right analytical approaches, from experimentation and causal inference through to statistical modelling and machine learning. Help connect Data Science work to measurable customer, product and commercial outcomes. Work with Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning and other Data disciplines to ensure teams have the data, tooling and infrastructure they need. Contribute to the wider Data Science discipline at Monzo, helping us continually raise the bar for how we work. 🤩 We'd love to hear from you if... What we're doing at Monzo excites you! You have significant experience managing and developing Data Scientists. You're a strong strategic data leader who uses data to influence decisions and direction. You have experience partnering with senior and executive stakeholders across different functions and levels of seniority. You're comfortable working autonomously in a fast-growing and evolving organisation. You have a strong understanding of Data Science approaches including experimentation, causal inference, statistical analysis and machine learning. You're comfortable with tools and languages such as Python and SQL, and understand how to choose the right analytical approach for a problem. You can build credibility with Product, Engineering and senior business leaders and influence without relying on authority. You have strong product judgement and experience using Data Science to shape product development and strategy. You know how to balance technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making and business impact. You have experience helping Data Scientists develop their technical, product and leadership capabilities. The interview process Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions! 30-minute recruiter call 45-minute call with the hiring manager 3 x 1-hour video calls with various team members Our average process takes around 3–4 weeks, but we'll always work around your availability. You'll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during the process. What's in it for you ✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK ✅ We can sponsor visas 📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK, with ad hoc meetings in London. ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team. 📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences ➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here #LI-LG1 #LI-Remote Equal opportunities for everyone Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report. We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status. If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

items.title: Senior Data Scientist, Hardware Quality
items.summary: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights…
items.description: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. At Oura, our mission is to empower every person to own their inner potential. With our award-winning Oura Ring and app, we help millions of people turn insights about sleep, activity, and readiness into healthier, more balanced lives.We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to partner with Oura’s Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Support Engineering, and Finance teams. This role will help build the data science and decision systems that make Oura hardware more reliable, from early product testing and launch readiness through field performance, warranty outcomes, and long-term product improvement.You will work on some of the most important problems in consumer hardware: understanding why products fail, predicting reliability before issues reach members, connecting manufacturing and testing data to field outcomes, and turning complex engineering data into clear decisions. This is a full-stack applied data science role that combines data foundations, statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and cross-functional technical leadership. What You Will Do: Build and evolve reliability and quality models for current and next-generation Oura Ring products, including warranty forecasts, runtime degradation, survival analysis, failure-mode prediction, and cohort-based field-performance analysis. Develop diagnostics and root-cause analysis systems that connect ring telemetry, firmware and engineering diagnostics, manufacturing records, supplier and component data, testing results, activations, and warranty outcomes. Partner with Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Battery Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Support Engineering to identify the highest-leverage reliability risks and translate them into measurable analytical problems. Analyze component, supplier, manufacturing-process, and ring-build variation to identify drivers of product quality and inform corrective actions, design decisions, and supplier-quality improvements. Build trusted analytical data products and pipelines that unify hardware, manufacturing, firmware, diagnostic, activation, and warranty data and make them usable for recurring analysis and decision-making. Develop production AI-enhanced dashboards, monitoring, and decision-support tools that surface emerging failure risks and provide clear, actionable recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders. Establish robust measurement practices for hardware quality, including metric definitions, cohorting, normalization, uncertainty, data-quality checks, and appropriate statistical methods. Translate complex technical findings into concise recommendations that influence hardware roadmaps, launch decisions, quality plans, firmware priorities, warranty strategy, and member experience. Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional problems and help raise the bar for data science practices through documentation, peer review, reusable tooling, and mentorship. This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco. What you'll bring: 6+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, reliability engineering, quality analytics, or a closely related quantitative field, with a track record of owning high-impact problems end to end. Demonstrated experience applying statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, or advanced analytics to reliability, quality, manufacturing, hardware, IoT, electronics, automotive, medical devices, or another physical-product domain. Strong experience with reliability and time-to-event methods, such as survival analysis, hazard modeling, accelerated-life testing, degradation modeling, warranty forecasting, or related techniques. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building analytical data models, statistical or machine-learning workflows, and production-quality measurement systems. Strong data-engineering intuition, including experience unifying and transforming data from multiple operational and technical systems into reliable datasets for analysis and modeling. Experience working with noisy, incomplete, longitudinal, or high-volume telemetry and test data, and the judgment to distinguish data artifacts from meaningful product signals. Experience designing experiments or observational analyses that support technical decisions, including an understanding of confounding, bias, uncertainty, and validation. Experience with modern cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, AWS, dbt, Snowflake, or similar tools. Proven ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to engineers, quality and operations partners, product leaders, and executives. Proven ability to work effectively across distributed, cross-functional teams and to drive progress when requirements and data are still evolving. Nice to have: Experience with consumer electronics, wearables, IoT, batteries, embedded systems, firmware, sensors, or connected devices. Experience analyzing manufacturing, supplier, component traceability, MES, ERP, engineering test, or warranty data. Experience with battery degradation, runtime modeling, charging optimization, power management, or electronics reliability. Experience building field-failure analysis, anomaly detection, predictive-maintenance, or early-warning systems. Familiarity with hardware development and launch processes, including EVT, DVT, PVT, and field-test programs. Benefits At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: Competitive salary and equity packages Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Region 1 $172,000- $203,000 Region 2 $158,950- $187,000 Region 3 $147,900- $174,000 A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: ŌURA does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ŌURA employees, or any other organization's location. ŌURA is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

items.description: Europe or India, Remote _______________________________________________ Hello👋I am Puneet , Co-founder and CPO at Kayzen , and I am now looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team 🙌 But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before?😃 Kayzen is the Apps DSP: an AI-native platform built on its own bidding engine, for buying app inventory across mobile and connected TV screens. App developers, agencies, media buyers and ad platforms use Kayzen to drive full-funnel outcomes across both screens, from awareness and consideration to installs, purchases and calls. Available through self-serve and managed services, Kayzen combines machine-learning optimisation with bid - and impression-level transparency, granular control over buying decisions, and AI capabilities that connect campaign data to the AI assistants teams already use. Kayzen’s vision is to democratise programmatic marketing by making it accessible to every team. Headquartered in Berlin, Kayzen operates globally. The Team You will work with a carefully selected, diverse, senior and globally distributed Data Science team (like Heiko , Chen ) on various machine-learning models that process terabytes of data, serving billions of ad requests and users around the globe in real-time. We are highly motivated and aligned in our quest to disrupt the multi-billion dollar ad-tech industry. We would like you to be part of our journey, as our Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d) . Responsibilities Our day-to-day work in Data Science and Machine Learning encompasses a wide range of activities, including: Enhancing Models: Continuously improving existing models by incorporating new features, fine-tuning parameters, and utilizing additional data. Algorithm Development: Collaborating with our Machine Learning Engineering team to develop and deploy scalable supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms. Data Exploration: Identifying and exploring new data sources while researching innovative ways to leverage both new and existing data effectively. Solution Research: Investigating new Machine Learning solutions to optimize every step of our value chain. A/B Testing: Regularly conducting and evaluating A/B tests to drive insights and refine our strategies. You’ll be a great fit if you resonate with the following principles of Data Science and Machine Learning: Simplicity First: We prioritize finding the best solutions to challenges rather than forcing problems to fit predetermined solutions. Impact-Driven: We leverage Machine Learning to enhance our product and drive performance for our clients, always focusing on tangible business outcomes. Collaborative Spirit: Our teams consist of analysts, engineers, and data scientists, making strong communication skills essential for success. Embrace Experimentation: We believe in the power of experimentation to innovate and refine our approach continually. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com . Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky” Mineralys is a fully remote company. HR Technology & Analytics Specialist The HR Technology and Analytics Specialist supports HR systems, reporting, and workforce analytics activities, with a focus on Workday HCM. The role provides day-to-day HRIS support, develops and maintains standard and moderately complex reports, assists with system enhancements and testing, and supports HR data quality and governance processes. The position works with HR, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver accurate reporting and dashboards. The ideal candidate combines hands-on HR systems and reporting experience with strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication capabilities. Key Responsibilities HR Technology Support Provide day-to-day functional support for Workday and other HR technology platforms. Troubleshoot HR technology issues, research root causes, and coordinate resolution with HR, IT, vendors, and other stakeholders. Gather and document business requirements and support the development, testing, and deployment of Workday configuration changes under the guidance of senior HR Technology or IT resources. Identify and support process improvement opportunities by reviewing Workday system releases, documenting potential enhancements, and participating in approved HR technology enhancement projects. Support employee and manager self-service adoption through user guidance, training, support materials, and approved system or process enhancements. Participate in HR technology projects, implementations, integrations, and process improvement initiatives by completing assigned tasks or workstreams and escalating complex design decisions. Create and maintain system configuration documentation, process guides and end-user support materials for HR technology platforms and processes. HR Analytics and Reporting Develop, maintain, and enhance standard and moderately complex Workday reports, dashboards, and analytics based on established HR and business requirements. Create and maintain calculated fields and report logic within Workday to support standard and moderately complex workforce reporting requirements, seeking guidance for advanced designs. Use Workday reporting and analytics capabilities to validate data, summarize workforce trends, and respond to defined HR and business reporting needs. Develop and support recurring and ad hoc HR compliance reporting, including data validation and reconciliation to promote accuracy and timely delivery. Maintain and enhance established HR metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports. Summarize analytical findings and key trends clearly for technical and non-technical audiences, escalating requests that require advanced analysis or recommendations. Support HR stakeholders by preparing workforce reporting and summarizing key trends. Work with HR and IT stakeholders to document and validate HR data requirements and support testing for workforce data integrations and cross-functional dashboards, escalating complex integration design matters. Data Governance and Quality Maintain a centralized inventory of HR reports and documented definitions for workforce data and metrics. Monitor HR data quality and proactively identify inconsistencies or data integrity issues. Apply established HR data standards and governance practices and support related documentation, data quality checks, and issue follow-up. Perform audits and reconciliations to ensure HR data is accurate, complete, and reliable. Support the maintenance of established definitions for key workforce metrics and reporting dimensions, and document approved updates in partnership with HR stakeholders. Maintain appropriate confidentiality and security when working with sensitive employee information. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business, Analytics, or related field. 4+ years of experience in HRIS, HR analytics, HR reporting, or a related discipline. Hands-on experience with Workday HCM. Experience creating standard and moderately complex Workday reports, dashboards, and calculated fields. Working knowledge of HR data structures, workforce metrics, and HR business processes. Strong Microsoft Excel and analytical skills. Ability to communicate findings clearly and work with HR and IT stakeholders. Experience handling confidential and sensitive employee information. Preferred Experience using a business intelligence or visualization platform, preferably Power BI, to develop dashboards and communicate workforce insights. Knowledge of HR data governance and reporting security. Experience supporting workforce planning, organizational reporting, or established HR dashboards. Travel • 10% for occasional team and company meetings This position is eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level. US Salary Range: $115,000- $125,000 #LI-Remote

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote - USA Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding across legacy interoperability networks, QHIN/TEFCA connectivity, and direct HIE integrations, we need rigorous analytical ownership to ensure the clinical data powering our platform is complete, reliable, and actionable. You will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for clinical data completeness and effectiveness at Counterpart Health. Sitting within the Data Products pillar, this role owns the end-to-end understanding of our clinical data lifecycle: where data comes from, where it breaks down, and how each vendor or integration pathway performs across our customer markets. Your analysis will directly shape vendor strategy, facility targeting, and data pipeline investments, thus ensuring that the clinical evidence our care teams depend on is consistently available and trustworthy. As a Data Analyst, you will: Proactively identify and monitor which healthcare facilities consistently generate high-quality, usable clinical documents (e.g., EHRs, discharge summaries, procedure notes) to precisely locate and quantify data gaps. Conduct deep-dive analyses by mapping and correlating facility-specific data across disparate sources like structured claims, clinical care summaries (CCDAs), and ADT messages to uncover systematic patterns of missingness, latency, Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. or incongruence in clinical records. Establish and maintain clear, transparent reporting on ADT coverage across key geographic, organizational, and technological dimensions (e.g., by county, facility, and underlying EMR system). Based on rigorous analysis of data flow and quality, recommend and guide the implementation of optimal technical configurations for existing data vendors (e.g., Bamboo Health, PCC, Experian, HSX). Conduct comprehensive evaluations and proof-of-concepts for potential new data integration technologies (e.g., Kno2 vs. Particle Health) to assess viability, quality improvements, and strategic fit. Systematically determine the existence and completeness of documentation associated with specific patient visits or encounters. Develop a data-driven framework for prioritizing facility targets for direct data acquisition, assessing impact, cost-effectiveness, and technical feasibility. Inform and guide vendor strategy around national initiatives such as TEFCA and QHIN adoption, ensuring Counterpart Health is positioned for compliant, high-quality data exchange. Partner cross-functionally with Product Managers to define data requirements, Engineers to implement reliable pipelines, and Clinical teams to validate data quality and clinical utility. Act as a critical liaison to identify and remove operational and technical bottlenecks, ensuring a predictable, scalable, and reliable clinical data flow across all customer markets. You should get in touch if you have: 5+ years of hands-on data analytics experience, with direct exposure to healthcare data interoperability Strong hands-on experience with healthcare data standards: HL7, CCDA, and ADT messages. Proficiency in SQL and comfort working with large, complex datasets (claims, clinical logs, interoperability data). Background in analyzing interoperability networks (e.g., Carequality, CommonWell, eHealthExchange) or HIE integrations. Skilled at data visualization and able to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong investigative mindset, i.e., you enjoy digging into the “why” behind missing data and diverging metrics. Self-directed and able to manage multiple analytical projects (vendor comparisons, visit-level reconciliation) without constant supervision. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care. With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software. Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clover-health-data-analyst-clinical-data-effectiveness

We’re looking for people with genuine depth in their field: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking answer is quietly wrong. Required Skills Research Data Analysis Experimental Design Scientific Writing Statistical Analysis Laboratory Skills Wet Lab Clinical Research MATLAB Python SolidWorks Biostatistics Epidemiology Clinical Trials Data Visualization Spectroscopy Chromatography What you’ll do Design difficult technical problems drawn from your own research area, with realistic constraints and supporting data. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another researcher reviewing the work would reach the same verdict. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them. What we’re looking for Completed PhD in a STEM field. This is a hard requirement. Hands-on research experience — work you did yourself, not work you read about. Wet lab, research lab, or academic experience is strongly preferred. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another researcher could verify it. Publications or a record of research contribution is a strong plus. Prior experience on AI training or evaluation projects is a plus, not a requirement. items.description: Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members. Position Overview: We are seeking a highly analytical and impact-driven Senior Data Scientist to help shape our product strategy and decision-making through data. In this role, you will focus on optimizing existing products while also supporting early-stage product initiatives where relevant. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to drive product innovation and optimization through data-driven insights. This position requires a passion for transforming data into actionable insights and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. What You’ll Do: Translate business needs into data analysis and actionable insights to optimize product performance and user experience for both existing and new products. Work closely with product managers, engineers, and other cross-functional stakeholders to identify critical product questions and provide data-driven solutions. Develop and maintain a scalable, reliable, and accurate analytics infrastructure to support product decisions. Establish and maintain best practices for data collection, analysis, and reporting. Deliver actionable insights and recommendations focused on landing tangible product impact. Help foster a culture of data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement within the product teams. Ensure the integrity and accuracy of the data used for analysis and reporting. While the primary focus is on existing products, support 0 to 1 product launches by identifying key metrics and analyzing early-stage product data when applicable. What You Bring: Strong experience in product analytics or a similar data-focused role, with a proven ability to impact product strategy and decision-making through data. Expertise in translating complex data into insights that are actionable for cross-functional teams. Proficiency with data analytics tools and platforms (e.g., Looker, Amplitude) is a plus but not required. A focus on solving product challenges is more important than specific tool experience. Experience in building and maintaining reliable analytics infrastructures. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly present data insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience with 0 to 1 product initiatives is a plus, though not required. A high level of accountability, a passion for continuous learning, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Qualifications: Degree in Analytics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, or related analytical field of study, or an equivalent combination of training and experience. Deep experience in working with exploratory analysis projects related to cohorting, time series analysis, and funnel analysis/optimization is required. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: URL: https://bpcs.com About Blueprint Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology. Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams. At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build. Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters. In This Role We are seeking a detail-oriented Supply Chain Planner to support short-term planning for server hardware deployment. In this role, you will help translate customer demand forecasts into actionable supply plans, track hardware availability, and ensure the right equipment is available at the right location and time. You will work extensively with Excel, planning systems, and operational data to reconcile information, identify supply and demand gaps, monitor inventory, and track deployment requirements. This is a hands-on position that requires strong supply chain knowledge, analytical skills, and a willingness to manage detailed manual processes to keep planning activities accurate and on schedule. You will collaborate with regional capacity managers and cross-functional partners, independently manage day-to-day planning responsibilities, and follow open actions through resolution. The ideal candidate enjoys working with data, solving operational challenges, and turning supply chain requirements into executable plans. Responsibilities Support short-term supply chain planning for server hardware deployment, translating customer demand forecasts into actionable supply plans. Partner with regional capacity managers and cross-functional teams to understand hardware requirements, priorities, quantities, and delivery timelines. Analyze demand and supply data to identify capacity gaps, inventory constraints, delivery risks, and potential mitigation actions. Create, update, and maintain demand entries in planning systems, ensuring accuracy across quantities, locations, and required delivery dates. Leverage Microsoft Excel to reconcile datasets, validate planning information, track changes, analyze capacity, and prepare operational reports. Monitor hardware inventory, supply availability, costs, lead times, and deployment schedules to support planning decisions. Perform detailed manual tracking and maintain accurate records of planning inputs, open actions, risks, and delivery progress. Follow up with partner teams to resolve discrepancies, address planning gaps, and ensure requirements progress from initial planning through execution. Independently manage daily planning activities while balancing multiple priorities and deadlines. Qualifications 5–7 years of experience in supply chain planning, demand planning, capacity planning, inventory planning, or related operations. Strong understanding of supply chain fundamentals, logistics, inventory management, and demand and supply planning processes. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, and reconciliation of large datasets. Hands-on experience creating, maintaining, updating, and validating demand or supply plans within planning systems. Experience analyzing supply and demand gaps, tracking inventory, monitoring lead times, and managing deployment schedules. Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify discrepancies, assess risks, and maintain accurate planning data. Comfortable performing detailed, hands-on operational work rather than focusing primarily on project coordination or oversight. Strong communication and follow-through skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate across multiple teams. Ability to work a consistent Pacific Time (PST) schedule. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field. Experience supporting hardware supply chain operations, server deployment, data center infrastructure, or technology logistics. Experience with capacity planning, resource allocation, and hardware inventory management. Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting and data visualization tools. Experience working with enterprise resource planning (ERP), supply chain management, or demand planning systems. Experience coordinating supply planning activities across geographically distributed teams. Salary Range At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market. For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated salary range is $33– $36 per hr. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maint
items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: US URL: https://knack.com Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote) If US-Based: This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval. International Contractor: This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone. Role Overview Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities. We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation. About Knack Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code. Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations. To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact. Key Responsibilities Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions. Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it. Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent. Make AWS and Claude work together Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes. Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do. Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability. Implement security controls with our security lead Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets. Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment. Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk. Support compliance and audits Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups. Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change. Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling. Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts. Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them. Keep systems patched and current Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals. Operate and scale databases and customer environments Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms. Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support. Resolve escalations and automate repeat work Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering. Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces. Participate in on-call Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat. Qualifications Experience 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number. Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation. A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally. Technical depth Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS. Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is. Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation. Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts. Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production. Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals. Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch. How you work with AI Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation. Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments. A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling. Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers. Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows. Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild. Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling). Kubernetes/EKS experience. Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats. Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knack-cloud-engineer-1

This role combines Tableau Next and Data 360 insight development, SQL/SOQL work, data-quality validation, field-user training, and daily use of AI copilots/agents to improve delivery speed while maintaining accountability for production decisions. General information This engagement is centered on Channel Insights, with responsibility spanning metrics, dimensions, refresh SLAs, dashboard logic, and executive-facing insight delivery. The work is not a report ticket queue; it requires ownership of the analytics layer and confidence in the numbers presented to leadership. Daily use of AI copilots/agents is an explicit expectation for discovery, build, test, and documentation. The focus is on improving cycle time and cost-to-outcome versus legacy delivery, embedding automation into quality gates, and verifying outputs before they reach production or executive readouts. Tasks and Deliverables Own Channel Insights metrics, dimensions, and refresh SLAs with the CDP product owner and Data Expert. Build Tableau Next and Data 360 calculated insights; write SQL/SOQL as needed. Validate data quality with the modeler/engineer and fix breaks at the source. Train field users through working sessions. Use AI for SQL and dataset drafts and insight narratives; verify every number before executive readouts. Automate anomaly commentary on Channel Insights where trustworthy; escalate false positives. Required experience 5+ years of analytics engineering or BI lead experience. Expert-level Tableau or equivalent BI platform experience. Strong storytelling with data for executives and field leaders. Experience using AI copilots/agents in analytics delivery with human verification. Nice to have: Experience with Salesforce CRM Analytics and/or Data 360. Engagement highlights Own a defined Channel Insights workstream across semantic-layer design, dashboards, and data quality. Work directly with cross-functional stakeholders, including product, data, engineering, and field users. Deliver executive-facing insights and automate repeatable commentary where the data is trustworthy. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-senior-analytics-engineer-bi-lead-channel-insights-ix360

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Turkey URL: https://sezzle.com The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $4,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them. What You’ll Do: Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others What We Look For: Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering Fluent in English Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. Preferred Knowledge and Skills: Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL The Tech You’ll Work With: Python Redshift, PostgreSQL Data build tool (dbt) WS, G Suite, Mac Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT Interview Process: Application submitted (you are here) Wonderlic test (30-40 min) Interview with recruiters (30 min) Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue. Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service. Offer About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. #Li-remote #Full-time To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-data-engineer-ii-credit-reporting

items.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer to drive significant business impact by shaping our data infrastructure, developing robust data models, and promoting best practices in analytics engineering (e.g., data quality, documentation, and scalable data architectures). You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders to identify and deliver high-value data solutions and provide informal mentorship to junior team members, fostering their growth and enhancing team capabilities. What you'll do: Create and maintain complex, scalable data models in Snowflake using dbt. Expose datasets effectively in BI tooling to enable robust self-service analytics. Perform simple data ingestion tasks using no-code tools and ensure streamlined data flows. Add comprehensive metadata to datasets, including documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking. Activate data by pushing it from Snowflake into other operational tools. Proactively identify and raise data quality issues to the respective process owners for resolution. Lead training sessions and initiatives to drive adoption and effective use of BI tools across the organization. Mentor junior analytics engineers, fostering knowledge-sharing and professional growth. We'd love to hear from you if you: Extensive experience in analytics engineering or related data roles, with demonstrated expertise in advanced SQL, dbt, and Snowflake. Proficient in using BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, PowerBI, Snowsight) to deliver clear, actionable insights for business stakeholders. Skilled in performing data ingestion and activation using no-code tools (e.g. Fivetran, Stitch), ensuring efficient data integration into operational systems. Knowledgeable in managing metadata, documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking effectively. Effective at collaborating closely with diverse stakeholders, understanding their data needs, and delivering impactful solutions. Experienced in conducting training sessions and providing informal mentorship to junior analytics team members, fostering a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment. Everyone is welcome at Paddle At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group. Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together. Why you’ll love working at Paddle We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture. We live and breathe our values, which are: Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us” Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple” Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs” We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training. Connecting at Paddle We’re a ‘digital-first’ company , which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations. We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration. Our Paddle hubs: In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub) In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada) Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work. To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects). At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security. You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions. You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices. You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability. You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility. You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability. You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution. You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies. Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Nice to Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Databricks experience or certification. Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services. Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks. Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund and Life Insurance Vacation and Parental Leave Internet and Electricity Allowance Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-sr-data-analytics-engineer-r14153
