PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices,…
items.description: What is PerfectServe ? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! The Manager of Marketing Operations is responsible for the operational foundation enabling Marketing to execute, measure, and scale effectively. Reporting to the Revenue Operations leader, this role serves as a key operational partner to Marketing leadership, translating go-to-market strategy into the processes, systems, data, and insights that connect marketing activity to pipeline and revenue. This role owns the day-to-day mechanics of marketing operations, including lead lifecycle management and routing, marketing automation, campaign operations, attribution execution, funnel analytics, marketing data quality, and the marketing technology stack. This role will work closely with Marketing and Sales Operations to create clear visibility across the buyer journey and ensure leads and accounts move between Marketing and Sales with speed, consistency, and the right context. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between systems, data, process, and business partnership. The right person will understand that great Marketing Operations is not simply about administering marketing technology or reporting campaign results. It is about building the operating infrastructure that allows Marketing to understand what is working, invest intelligently, and create measurable impact on pipeline and revenue. Key responsibilities Funnel and lead lifecycle operations Own the operational execution of the lead and account lifecycle from initial engagement through handoff to Sales. Design lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, scoring models, and routing logic in partnership with Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Sales, then implement and maintain them Manage lead and account routing to ensure high-quality opportunities reach the appropriate BDR or seller quickly and accurately. Monitor MQL-to-Sales acceptance, meeting conversion, opportunity creation, and other key funnel transitions to identify leakage and areas for improvement. Maintain and monitor SLAs between Marketing, BDRs, and Sales, surfacing breakdowns and partnering with leaders to resolve them. Ensure funnel definitions and system logic remain consistent across Marketing and Sales platforms. Assess the cross-functional impact of marketing operations initiatives, ensuring alignment across systems, processes, and teams. Marketing automation and campaign operations Own the operational infrastructure required to execute scalable, measurable marketing campaigns. Manage marketing automation workflows, segmentation, campaign structure, audience logic, and operational QA. Partner with Marketing teams to ensure campaigns are properly configured, tracked, and measurable. Establish campaign governance and naming conventions that create consistent and reliable reporting. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes and improve campaign execution speed and accuracy. Marketing analytics and funnel performance Collaborate with data analysts to create dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into funnel performance, campaign contribution, pipeline generation, conversion, velocity, and marketing effectiveness. Analyze performance across channels, campaigns, segments, products, personas, and stages of the buyer journey. Identify funnel leakage, conversion trends, engagement patterns, and opportunities to improve Marketing's contribution to pipeline and revenue. Move beyond reporting activity and volume to helping Marketing leadership understand what is driving business outcomes and where performance is changing. Partner with Sales Operations to provide a connected view of the funnel from initial engagement through opportunity creation and revenue. Attribution and measurement Design and own the attribution framework: select models, define sourced vs. influenced logic, and recommend changes as the funnel and buying journey evolve Ensure campaigns, contacts, accounts, and opportunities are structured appropriately to support reliable attribution and influence reporting. Maintain data and process integrity across the systems used to measure marketing contribution. Provide Marketing leadership with visibility into sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, and campaign performance. Help distinguish between activity metrics and the measures that indicate meaningful progression toward pipeline and revenue. Marketing technology and data Manage the day-to-day effectiveness and administration of marketing-specific technology within the broader GTM technology ecosystem. Partner with Revenue Operations on technology evaluation, implementation, integration, consolidation, and governance. Maintain integrations and data flows between marketing automation platforms, Salesforce, intent and account intelligence platforms, and other marketing systems. Own the strategy for data quality, enrichment, duplication, consent, and other issues affecting the usability and reliability of marketing data. Identify opportunities to use automation and AI to improve segmentation, routing, data enrichment, campaign execution, and insight generation. Continually evaluate whether technology is creating meaningful leverage or unnecessary complexity. Account-based and intent operations Operationalize account segmentation, targeting, intent signals, and account-based programs in partnership with Marketing and Sales. Ensure intent and engagement signals are surfaced to the appropriate Sales and BDR teams in a usable and actionable way. Support workflows that connect target-account activity across Marketing and Sales. Measure engagement and progression within priority accounts and help identify signals that warrant Sales action. Partner with Sales Operations to ensure account ownership, routing, and marketing activity are aligned. Planning and marketing performance Support annual and quarterly Marketing planning with funnel analysis, historical conversion data, pipeline requirements, and scenario modeling. Partner with Revenue Operations and Marketing leadership to translate revenue goals into measurable funnel requirements. Track performance against Marketing pipeline and funnel objectives throughout the year. Support Marketing leadership in understanding where investment is producing results and where assumptions may need to change. Cross-functional partnership Serve as a trusted operational partner to Marketing leadership and the broader Marketing organization. Partner closely with Sales Operations to ensure clean handoffs, shared definitions, reliable data, and visibility across the entire Marketing-to-Sales funnel. Work with Field Enablement to ensure sellers and BDRs understand how to interpret and act on marketing-generated signals, intent, campaigns, and programs. Surface operational issues quickly and coordinate resolution across Marketing, Sales, BDR, Revenue Operations, Finance, Field Enablement, and other teams as needed. Create repeatable processes that allow marketers to spend more time building effective programs and less time navigating systems, reconciling data, or troubleshooting operational issues. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Demand Operations, or a related B2B SaaS operations role. Experience supporting complex B2B marketing and sales organizations with enterprise and/or multi-product go-to-market motions. Strong experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketing Cloud Account Engagement/Pardot, Salesforce CRM, including lifecycle management, lead and account routing, campaign architecture, and data integration. Demonstrated experience with funnel analytics, lead scoring, attribution, campaign measurement, and marketing performance reporting. Experience with intent data, account-based marketing (ABM) platforms such as 6sense and Vector, enrichment tools such as Clay and ZoomInfo, and other GTM technologies. Strong analytical capabilities, including experience with BI/reporting tools and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. Strong understanding of B2B SaaS funnel metrics, including MQL conversion, Sales acceptance, opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, velocity, and attribution. Ability to work across Marketing and Sales and translate the needs of both functions into scalable processes. Strong business judgment, attention to detail, and ability to balance recurring operational responsibilities with larger improvement initiatives. Bias toward simplification, automation, scalability, and high-quality data. Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. We offer a salary range of $100,000-120,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team.The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support. We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations. Benefits: Remote first work environment Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one. 401K - with match and immediately vested. 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy Internal Advancement Opportunities PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position : Digital Marketing Specialist Salary : Up to $2,400 NZD per month Working Hours & Conditions : Part-Time, aligned with New Zealand business hours Work Arrangement : Remote ABOUT THE COMPANY: An innovative B2B SaaS platform serving the Allied Health clinic sector. By integrating directly with leading Patient Management Systems, their software provides branded, web-based patient intake forms and dedicated check-in kiosk solutions that streamline clinical operations and enhance the patient journey. Backed by an established strategic roadmap and marketing leadership, the organization is scaling its multi-channel footprint and market reach. ROLE OVERVIEW: Working directly alongside the Marketing Growth Lead, the Marketing Specialist acts as the core tactical execution engine for the brand. This role bridges high-level strategy and day-to-day operations by managing content output, web pages, email nurture sequences, and multi-channel campaigns. It is designed for an autonomous, execution-focused professional who excels at turning strategic roadmaps into measurable pipeline momentum in a fully remote setup. RESPONSIBILITIES: Content Production: Write, edit, and publish blog posts, resources, and case studies that speak to Allied Health clinic owners and practice managers. Manage the content calendar and maintain a consistent publishing cadence. Website & Landing Pages: Build and update pages in Webflow — including landing pages, feature pages, and conversion-focused content — to support campaigns and improve the buyer journey. Email Marketing: Set up and execute email campaigns including nurture sequences, onboarding flows, and re-engagement campaigns using our email marketing platform. Campaign Execution: Deploy and monitor marketing campaigns across B2B channels, including paid acquisition when required. Social Media: Maintain a consistent, high-quality presence across relevant social platforms. Plan, create, and schedule posts that build awareness and drive traffic. Review & Reputation Campaigns: Drive customer review campaigns to build social proof on relevant platforms. Performance Tracking: Monitor campaign and channel performance, pull basic reporting, and flag what's working and what isn't. You don't need to be a data analyst, but you should be comfortable reading dashboards and reporting on key metrics. Momentum Building: Proactively identifying the next steps needed to keep our growth roadmap on track. What We're Looking For Execution Focus: You love the "doing" part of marketing and take pride in seeing a plan come to life. Eye for design: Good instincts for layout, imagery, and visual consistency. You can create professional-looking assets without needing a designer for every task. Self-Starters: You are proactive and comfortable working independently within a defined strategy. Reliability: You are a consistent "engine" who can be counted on to deliver high-quality work. Comfortable with marketing tools like Slack, Webflow, G2, Gartner, Plausible Analytics, Google ecosystem B2B Experience: Ideally some marketing experience in the B2B SaaS landscape. Highly Desirable Direct background or familiarity with the Allied Health, healthcare, or clinic management software industry. Tech-forward mindset with an appetite for adopting modern AI tools to augment workflows, accelerate output, and maintain high operational leverage. Prior experience managing multi-channel paid acquisition campaigns. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-part-time-digital-marketing-specialist

items.summary: About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation’s leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $750M in bookings. We’re expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for home services: three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome), one shared platform. About Product at LawnStarter Our BHAG: 1+ job per househo
items.description: About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation’s leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $750M in bookings. We’re expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for home services: three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome), one shared platform. About Product at LawnStarter Our BHAG: 1+ job per household, every year. Getting there means winning on four fronts at once: more customers, more Pros, excellent service for both sides, and an AI-run company that moves faster than its size should allow. About the First Service Experience at LawnStarter Every new customer meets us the same way. They land on our home page or marketing site, then move through a signup and booking flow where they get a quote, pick a service and a schedule, and pay. That flow runs across all three brands and brings in most of the company’s new customers. We built it many years ago. It’s too long, and we lose customers at too many steps. So the real question isn’t how to remove a step. It’s whether the experience designed still makes sense at all, or whether it should be rethought entirely as an AI-native, agentic experience. The Role You’ll own the consumer’s first service experience: everything from the moment someone first encounters LawnStarter through signing up and booking their first service. You’ll decide what that experience should become, then build it with engineering, design, operations, marketing, and data. This is not a funnel-optimization job. We want someone who looks at a five-year-old flow, asks what a homeowner would want if we started from nothing today, and then ships the answer. As Lead PM, you’re an individual contributor with Lead-level scope and no direct reports. You’ll work closely with the Consumer Experience lead, the Pro Experience PM, the Pricing PM, and the Conversational AI & Agents lead. You’ll report to the Sr. Director of Product. What makes this role different: A rebuild, not a tune-up. You’re rethinking the experience from first principles, not polishing the one we have. AI-native from the first screen. You’ll decide whether a form is even the right way to sign up anymore. Every new customer passes through your work. Across three brands, this is how people meet LawnStarter. What You’ll Own The vision: What the first service experience should become, and the plan to get there. The home page and marketing site: The first impression, and the first decision a customer makes about us. Signup and booking for all three brands: LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome. Funnel data: The numbers that show where customers move forward and where they leave. Quotes, services, and scheduling: How a customer gets a price, picks a service, and chooses when it happens. Payment: Checkout, including Apple Pay and Google Pay. Problems to Solve Deciding whether today’s experience should exist at all. You’ll start from what a homeowner needs to book their first service and work backward. Every step we have today has to earn its place again, and you’ll defend each call with evidence. Designing an AI-native, agentic way to sign up. Someone who wants their lawn mowed shouldn’t have to learn our product to book it. What can an agent handle for them, and where does a person still want control? You’ll answer with prototypes in front of real customers, not opinions in a meeting. Rebuilding without breaking what works. This flow brings in most of our new customers. You’ll need a path that proves the new experience works with real customers before it replaces the old one. Bold and careful at once: that’s the job. Moving levers you don’t own. Signup touches pricing, Pro supply, and operations. Change how customers book and you change what Pros see and how jobs get priced. You’ll work through the people who own those levers and bring them along on a vision that changes their world too. What Success Looks Like (Year 1) A vision leadership rallies behind: A clear picture of the reimagined first service experience, grounded in what customers need. A first piece of it, live: A meaningful part of that experience shipped to real customers. Not a deck. Signup conversion goes up: More of the people who find us become customers. More customers sign up for their first service: The reimagined experience gets more households to that first booking. First service CSAT is high: Customers rate their first service experience highly (customer satisfaction, CSAT). Who You Are: Experience: Customer obsessed with 6+ years in consumer product management, focused on consumer experience. A visionary who ships. You look at an experience everyone has accepted and ask why it exists. Then you build the replacement. Is your instinct to improve what’s there, one step at a time? Then this isn’t your role. Customer-obsessed, for the long run. You care whether a customer converts and whether they’re glad they did. Short-term signups never win over the customer’s experience in your book. Someone who’d juice conversion at the customer’s expense won’t last here. An AI builder. You’ve shipped AI-powered or agentic consumer experiences. You prototype new signup experiences with LLMs and agents, read customer transcripts to hear where people get stuck, and use AI to pull apart funnel data in an afternoon. If you’ve only watched AI from the sidelines, this role is unlikely to be a good fit. Your own analyst. You run your own funnel analysis and product analytics, and you know which step loses people before anyone builds you a dashboard. If you need someone else to pull your numbers, this is unlikely to be a good fit. A strategist and a design partner. You set priorities, say no with reasons, and work beside design from the first sketch. PMs who hand designers a finished spec, or wait to be handed finished designs, will struggle. A plus: marketplace and personalization experience. You know a change to signup ripples into Pros, pricing, and operations, and you’ve built experiences that adapt to each customer. Treat signup as a self-contained form and you’ll miss half the problem. Minimum Bachelor’s degree in business, analytics, engineering, design, or a related field, plus 6+ years of product management experience on consumer-facing products. This Role Is NOT A people-management role. You’re an individual contributor with no direct reports. A growth-tactics role. If your best work is button tests and drip-email tweaks, this isn’t the fit. We need the experience reimagined, not tuned. For someone without a real consumer experience background . If you haven’t spent your career building for consumers, please don’t apply. A strategy-only seat. You’ll prototype with AI tools, read transcripts, and get into the data yourself. If you’d rather only set direction, this will frustrate you. A role with a big team, a clean stack, or every lever. We’re frugal: a lean engineering team and a partly legacy stack, and much of this experience touches levers other teams own. You’ll get impact by choosing carefully, using AI to outpace headcount, and influencing what you don’t control. Equity: Every new customer meets LawnStarter through the experience you build. Equity means you share in the company value that creates. Base salary: $170,000 to $210,000 Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision Location: Fully remote (US). Rethinking an experience from first principles takes long stretches of focus, and remote work protects them. PTO: Flexible. We focus on results. Take what you need. LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.

This Role Is NOT A people-management role. You’re an individual contributor with no direct reports. A growth-tactics role. If your best work is button tests and drip-email tweaks, this isn’t the fit. We need the experience reimagined, not tuned. For someone without a real consumer experience background . If you haven’t spent your career building for consumers, please don’t apply. A strategy-only seat. You’ll prototype with AI tools, read transcripts, and get into the data yourself. If you’d rather only set direction, this will frustrate you. A role with a big team, a clean stack, or every lever. We’re frugal: a lean engineering team and a partly legacy stack, and much of this experience touches levers other teams own. You’ll get impact by choosing carefully, using AI to outpace headcount, and influencing what you don’t control. Equity: Every new customer meets LawnStarter through the experience you build. Equity means you share in the company value that creates. Base salary: $170,000 to $210,000 Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision Location: Fully remote (US). Rethinking an experience from first principles takes long stretches of focus, and remote work protects them. PTO: Flexible. We focus on results. Take what you need. LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.

items.summary: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online wi
items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. About the Role Cloudflare runs one of the world’s largest networks, and every API call that configures it, from any customer, integration, or internal service, starts by proving who is calling and what they’re allowed to do. The IAM team owns the authentication and authorization systems behind that: the identity layer of the Control Plane operating at global scale. Our surface spans things like login and SSO, OAuth and API tokens, account membership, roles and permissions, and SCIM provisioning. We’re hiring a hands-on Principal Engineer to shape the technical direction of Cloudflare’s IAM platform and lead complex initiatives across teams. You’ll work from architecture through production code and rollout, evolving services under live traffic to deliver new customer capabilities, greater scale, edge-native execution, and support for data residency requirements. You’ll help teams make sound tradeoffs between security, correctness, latency, and availability. Responsibilities Architecture & strategy: Set the technical direction and delivery strategy for IAM, connecting customer needs with architectural decisions and practical, incremental investments. Technical leadership & delivery: Lead complex initiatives across engineering teams, resolve ambiguity, build agreement on tradeoffs, and carry decisions through implementation and production rollout. Hands-on engineering: Design, build, and debug critical authentication and authorization services, including safe migrations and backward-compatible API changes. Security & reliability: Partner with Security to strengthen threat models and tenant isolation. Guide reliability improvements through observability, incident learning, and resilient system design. Mentorship & engineering judgment: Develop senior and staff engineers through design collaboration, code reviews, and clear technical decisions. Engineering effectiveness & automation : Identify and lead investments in automation and AI that improve how teams build, test, and operate IAM services. Prioritize measurable improvements in delivery speed, reliability, and engineering capacity while maintaining security and correctness. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Extensive experience: A sustained record of building and operating large-scale production systems, setting technical direction across teams, and delivering complex initiatives with measurable customer or operational impact. Identity expertise: Deep experience building production authentication or authorization systems, with sound judgment around identity protocols, permission models, tenant isolation, and credential and session lifecycles. Distributed systems mastery: Proven track record in designing, architecting, and debugging large-scale distributed systems that handle global traffic. Languages & storage: Strong backend engineering skills and willingness to work extensively in Go, with practical depth in relational data modeling, transactions, caching, and distributed consistency. Experience with Go and PostgreSQL is particularly relevant. API stewardship: Significant experience designing and versioning public-facing APIs that are used by millions of developers. Bonus Points Cloudflare ecosystem: Experience building on Cloudflare Workers or similar serverless/edge computing environments. Observability advocate: A passion for building “observable” systems using Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana to proactively identify failures. Infrastructure as code: Experience with modern containerized deployment (Docker & Kubernetes), Terraform , and infrastructure automation. Security mindset: A background in security engineering or formal verification of protocol implementations. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

items.summary: About League League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. items.description: About League League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side. Position Summary: This is a builder role, not a maintainer role — equal parts strategy and execution. You're the most senior growth marketing hire on a team that's re-building its demand generation engine. You'll have the budget, a team, and direct access to leadership to do it. You'll be marketing into two of the most sought-after B2B buyer groups in health tech: payers with long procurement cycles and multiple clinical/financial stakeholders, and providers balancing patient experience against margin pressure. If you want to prove you can build and run demand gen at enterprise scale, in a category where the sales cycle actually tests your craft, this is that proving ground. You're inheriting a full, well-funded MarTech stack — Salesforce, Pardot, Bizible, Demandbase, and Qualified — and the website itself, but the job isn't to just run any of it as-is. We want someone who rebuilds how that stack operates to be agentic-first: designing AI agents that pull signal to plan campaigns, launch and sequence them across channels, and continuously test and optimize without manual hand-offs between tools. What You'll Do: Own and optimize our tech stack and website Own pipeline generation across paid search, paid social (LinkedIn), SEO, content, lifecycle/email, and account-based marketing Continuously test messaging, creative, and campaign structure — and bring examples of non-boilerplate campaigns that actually moved pipeline Own reporting: define KPIs and dashboards, and keep pipeline numbers trusted by Sales Own the AI-Native Workflow strategy and AI Engine Optimization (AEO): as buyers increasingly use LLMs to research vendors, you have ideas on how to build League's presence in those results Strategically partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing and Revenue Operations Security-Related Responsibilities Compliance with Information Security Policies Ensure access management is performed in compliance with the employee's role and responsibilities Responsibility and accountability for executing League's policies and procedures within the department/ team Notification of HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches or policy violations What You'll Bring: 7+ years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, with real ownership of pipeline outcomes — not just campaign support Enterprise background: you've marketed to large, complex organizations with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders; payer or provider experience is a strong plus Hands-on across the full stack: paid search, paid social (LinkedIn), SEO, content, and account-based marketing Fluent in the pipeline metrics that matter here — MQL/SQL/SQO conversion, pipeline contribution, cost per opportunity — not just CAC/LTV/ROAS Real experience building AI agents or automations, not just prompting a chatbot — bonus if you already gravitate toward MCP-first, Salesforce-native tools Strategic and hands-on: you're equally excited to set the plan and execute it Bonus: experience with ABM platforms like Demandbase or 6sense Bonus: experience in HealthTech, FinTech, InsurTech, or other large enterprise-focused products CANADA APPLICANTS ONLY: The Canada-specific compensation range below for this full-time position is exclusive of bonus, equity and benefits. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for base salaries for the position across all Canadian locations. The salary range is intentional to account for the performance and career progressions a Leaguer will experience in the role throughout their time at League. Where in the band you may land is determined by job-related skills/experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range specific to your skills and experience during the hiring process. Compensation range for Canada applicants only $145,000—$170,000 CAD AI Fluency & Ways of Working At League, we are an AI-native organization . We expect all employees regardless of role or level to thoughtfully leverage AI to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. What this means in practice: Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making (e.g., drafting, analysis, coding, research, or process automation) Apply judgment and accountability when using AI by reviewing outputs for accuracy, bias, and quality before use Continuously learn and adapt as new AI tools and capabilities emerge, incorporating them into your ways of working Identify opportunities to improve how work gets done from personal productivity to team-level workflows by leveraging AI effectively Operate with strong data responsibility and security awareness , especially when working with sensitive or regulated information How this scales by level: Individual Contributors: Use AI to improve personal productivity and quality of output Senior ICs / Managers: Integrate AI into team workflows and improve processes Leaders: Drive AI adoption at the organizational level and shape how work is done across teams What we look for: Demonstrated experience using AI tools in a practical, responsible way Curiosity and openness to experimenting with new technologies Ability to balance efficiency with quality and sound judgment Our employees come from different backgrounds, and we celebrate those differences. We are looking for the best candidates for our open roles, but do not expect applicants to meet every qualification in order to be considered. If you are excited about what you could accomplish at League and believe you can add value to our team, we would love to hear from you. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you are an individual in need of assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please contact us at recruitinginfo@league.com . Our Application Process: Applying to a role you love can be exhausting, and understanding the next steps can feel vague and uncertain. You have done the hard part of submitting your application; let's do ours by sharing potential next steps You should receive a confirmation email after submitting your application. A recruiter (not a computer) reviews all applications at League. If we see alignment with League's needs, a recruiter will reach out to learn more about your goals. The recruiter will also share the team-specific interview process depending on the roles you are exploring. The final step is an offer, which we hope you will accept! Prior to joining us, we conduct reference and background checks. Additional checks could be required for US Candidates, depending on the role you are exploring. Here are some additional resources to learn more about League: Learn about our platform, leadership team and partners Highmark Health, Google Cloud, League: new digital front door to seamless care Former Providence President and Workday EVP of Corporate Strategy join League Board of Directors League raises $95 million USD in Series C to build world’s leading healthcare CX platform Forbes x League: The Platformization Of Healthcare Is Here Fast Company x League: If we want better innovations in healthtech, we need more competition Work Location: We have a mix of office-centric roles based in our vibrant Toronto office, and remote-eligible roles based anywhere in Canada or US. Each job posting will indicate where the role will be based. Regardless of the role’s posted location, all Toronto-area Leaguers (living within 65 km of our downtown HQ) collaborate in-office Monday through Thursday. Depending on your distance to the office, you’ll enjoy 10 or 20 Flexible Remote Days each quarter for focus and deep-work time. We are committed to fostering a meaningful work environment and connections for all Leaguers regardless of location. Recognize and Avoid Employment scams. Practice safe job searching. Scammers are getting craftier and leveraging fake job postings to get personal information. Know the warning signs and protect yourself from scammers. Learn more here . Use of AI Notice We are committed to ensuring fairness and transparency throughout our hiring process. League may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the screening of applicants for this position. Please check out our stance on using AI in recruitment here . Privacy Policy Review our Privacy Policy for information on how League is protecting personal data.

items.description: Location Details: At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​ Remote: This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. About The Team.... Global Compute runs Optimised Hosting, GoDaddy's global platform for all customer hosting products. Squad R is the engineering team responsible for operating, scaling, and continuously improving the OpenStack-based clouds that power that platform. We treat reliability as an engineering problem: we automate toil away, we plan capacity ahead of demand, and we instrument everything so that we understand our systems before they surprise us. As an SRE III on the team, you'll be a senior technical contributor who others lean on for the hard problems. What you'll get to do... Operate and scale GoDaddy's cloud infrastructure, including our OpenStack-based hosting platform. You'll troubleshoot and improve services spanning compute, networking, and storage in large-scale production environments. Drive the OpenStack migration. Help move customer hosting workloads onto the platform safely — designing and executing migration tooling, validation, and rollback strategies that protect customer experience. Work within a large-scale global hosting environment supporting thousands of servers and customer workloads across multiple regions. Eliminate toil through automation. Build and maintain automation in Python and Puppet to replace manual operational work. Treat repeated manual effort as a bug to be fixed. Strengthen observability. Improve monitoring, alerting, and dashboards so that signal reaches the right engineer at the right time, and so that we can reason about system behavior from data. Participate in on-call and incident response. Take a fair share of the on-call rotation, lead incident response when you're the responder, and drive the blameless post-incident process that turns failures into permanent fixes. Raise the engineering bar. Review peers' code and designs, document systems and runbooks clearly, and mentor SRE engineers. Contribute to the AI/MCP initiative. Help bring AI-assisted workflows and internal MCP tooling into our operations so internal customers can resolve problems and incidents faster. Participate in a shared on-call rotation (after onboarding) and help lead incident response activities when needed. Your experience should include... 5+ years in SRE, infrastructure, platform, or systems engineering roles operating production systems at scale. Strong Linux systems fundamentals — networking, storage, processes, performance troubleshooting. Proficiency in Python for automation and tooling (writing maintainable, tested code — not just scripts). Hands-on experience operating distributed systems and diagnosing issues across service boundaries. Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management (Puppet, Ansible, or equivalent). Comfort owning production reliability: on-call experience, incident response, and a track record of reducing toil through automation. Clear written and verbal communication — able to document systems, write post-incident reviews, and collaborate across a distributed, remote team. You might also have... Experience operating OpenStack (Nova, Neutron, Ceph) or comparable cloud infrastructure platforms Experience with Docker, Kolla, or containerised infrastructure Experience supporting large distributed systems at scale Experience operating Ceph or other software-defined storage at scale. Exposure to OpenStack migration or cloud-migration programs. Interest in applying AI/LLM tooling to operational workflows. We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth. We've got your back... We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process. About us... GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us . At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page . We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups ( Culture ). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way. GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy. Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com. GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.

items.description: About the Role We're looking for a Director of EMEA Sales Operations to be the dedicated GTM Operations partner for our EMEA region. This role sits at the centre of EMEA's go-to-market motion, spanning New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across a fast-growing, multi-country region. You will partner directly with the VP of EMEA and the region's Account Executives, Business Development Reps, and Solutions Architects to deliver the insights, enablement, and processes that power territory design, quota allocation, pipeline and forecasting hygiene, and the region's operating cadence. Because EMEA spans many countries and time zones relative to global GTM Operations and Systems teams based in the US, this role requires someone who can operate with real autonomy, exercise judgment on what to escalate versus solve locally, and represent EMEA's specific needs (FSI and financial services-heavy Strategic accounts across UK/Ireland and DACH, multiple hybrid Commercial motions, territory splits across UK/Ireland, DACH, Nordics, and Southern Europe) back into Temporal's global GTM Operations function. We're building a GTM Operations function that is AI-native from the ground up. We expect this leader to bring demonstrated experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, surface insights, and scale operational work—not as a future aspiration, but as a core part of how they work today. Responsibilities Serve as the dedicated Sales Operations partner for EMEA, supporting New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across the region, and knowing when to solve locally versus escalate to global GTM Operations or Systems. Partner with the VP of EMEA and regional sales leadership to deliver actionable insights on net-new pipeline generation, account penetration, and territory design. Own pipeline visibility and forecasting hygiene across all EMEA motions, including large complex enterprise deals, consumption workload ramps, and Commercial/self-serve pipeline. Conduct white-space and TAM analysis to identify high-propensity targets across EMEA's markets, with particular attention to the region's concentration of financial services, banking, and fintech accounts. Identify process gaps across the region's hunting, growth, and hybrid motions, and partner with GTM Systems to scope and implement automation—including AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and increase regional coverage. Analyse regional sales performance (win/loss, deal velocity, conversion, quota attainment) across segments, and translate findings into clear recommendations for the VP of EMEA and regional leaders; leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and surface patterns at scale. Build and maintain Salesforce and Omni reporting and dashboards tailored to EMEA, supporting Strategic, Growth, and Commercial views (including CQA/Tiered account, SSU, and workload metrics specific to the region). Support the region's full operating cadence: forecasting calls, QBRs, pipeline reviews, and account planning sessions, often prepping leadership with regional metrics ahead of cross-timezone reviews. Drive annual and in-year planning for EMEA: capacity plans, territory carving and re-carving (including account transitions as reps' territories evolve), and quota allocation across New Logo, Growth, and Commercial. Evaluate new market entry and partner with regional GTM leadership on market expansion priorities, including coverage models and impacts to org design. Qualifications Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Field Operations supporting a B2B enterprise or strategic sales organization in technology or software. Proven track record supporting multiple sales motions at once: net-new logo hunting, growth/expansion within existing accounts, and self-serve or hybrid AE-assisted motions. Demonstrated AI-native working style: hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion AI, or purpose-built GTM AI tools) to accelerate analysis, automate repeatable ops tasks, generate insights from large datasets, and improve the speed and quality of decision-making. We are not looking for theoretical familiarity—we want to see how AI is embedded in how you work today. Deep experience across EMEA markets and fluency in the cultural and commercial similarities and differences across these markets. Hands-on experience with building equitable territories, account scoring, quota allocation, and capacity modelling across a multi-country region. Strong Salesforce expertise, including building scalable reports and dashboards across multiple sales motions and segments. Highly analytical, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights for regional sales leadership; comfortable pairing SQL, BI tools, and AI assistants to move faster and go deeper. Strong cross-functional partner who can work effectively with regional sales and SA leadership, global GTM Operations, GTM Systems, and Marketing. Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior regional and global leadership. Able to operate both strategically and tactically depending on business needs. Bonus: experience operating in a consumption-based business, with a strong understanding of how usage impacts forecasting, pipeline, and quota planning for newly acquired and expanding accounts. Bonus: experience evaluating or deploying AI-powered GTM tools (e.g., AI forecasting, account scoring, pipeline intelligence, or conversation intelligence platforms) and driving adoption across a regional sales team. Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity. Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.

items.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo , the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Partnerships Team The Partnerships team sources, negotiates, and manages external relationships behind DuckDuckGo's products, from AI model and cloud infrastructure providers to distribution, content, and monetization partners. Alongside that work, the team also handles a steady stream of vendor deals for the software, tooling, and service contracts that keeps the company running. Our Need We are seeking a well-established, independent Procurement Advisor Practice to advise the partnerships team in DuckDuckGo's vendor selection, procurement and negotiations. Our procurement efforts cover a broad set of vendors including collaboration tools, AI services, SaaS, analytics and data tools, developer tooling, and professional services. We are seeking a procurement advisory practice that will provide our team with counsel on needs scoping, vendor identification, vendor conversations, price negotiations strategies and benchmarks, and guidance on proposed terms. DuckDuckGo remains responsible for our internal processes and approvals, and for signing vendor contracts. Advisory Practice Profile 10+ years advisory practice in procurement, strategic sourcing, or vendor management, with a focus on software and SaaS. Your practice has provided direction on hundreds of contracts and has deep enough experience to provide clients with guidance on where the leverage usually is. Your practice has a well-established approach to commercial and contractual details -- including deep experience in providing guidance on order forms, MSAs, and DPAs terms, a time-tested methodology for vendor comparison, and proven track record of working across a client organization including with legal, security, finance, product, engineering. Your practice has sufficient capacity to advise many small deals in parallel, each with a different internal owner. Your practice has deep experience in providing deal advisory across a broad set of vendors: collaboration, recruiting, analytics, developer tooling, data and research subscriptions, professional services. Your practice has a proven track record of building trust quickly with client teams, providing clear client communications, and working asynchronously across multiple time zones in North America and Europe. Your practice care s about privacy and has experience in navigating data handling and security issues with clients and vendors. Your practice is an established business: an operating entity or registered sole proprietorship with other current clients, its own professional liability insurance, and client references available on request. Your practice is located in the US. Engagement Details We expect the scope of work to cover an estimated 3 to 5 deals per month (estimated approximately 15-20 hours per week) compensated by a fixed rate, with pricing for additional volume set out in the statement of work, starting with an initial six-month term with the option to extend. This is a business-to-business services engagement, not employment. Your practice will deliver advisory services remotely on its own schedule with working sessions scheduled by mutual agreement. Your practice will use its own equipment, tools, and methods. DuckDuckGo will provide the deal information and access to internal deal owners needed for each engagement, and limited system access where a specific deal requires it. As an independent consultant, your practice is responsible for its own taxes, insurance, and business expenses, and invoices DuckDuckGo monthly under the statement of work. How to Submit a Proposal Please send a short proposal to bdhiring@duckduckgo.com with the subject line of “Procurement Advisory Services“ covering your practice's background and structure, representative clients and references, your proposed approach and the personnel who would perform the work, and your fee proposal for the scope above. Nondiscrimination Policy DuckDuckGo evaluates proposals without discrimination on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws. We want to ensure that our selection process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the proposal process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to bdhiring@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request. Please note that: Your practice will be subject to DuckDuckGo's standard vendor due diligence, including privacy and security review, and must confirm that any personnel assigned to the engagement have passed a background check conducted by your practice. By submitting a proposal, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information is cause for rejection of the proposal or immediate termination of the engagement. DISCLOSURE STATEMENT: USE OF AI IN VENDOR SELECTION As part of our commitment to enhancing our vendor evaluation process, we use artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to help review and summarize proposals, flag potentially fraudulent submissions, and compare proposals against our evaluation criteria. All final selection decisions are made by DuckDuckGo personnel. Information you submit will be handled in accordance with our privacy policies. If you have questions, contact bdhiring@duckduckgo.com . Thank you for your interest in working with DuckDuckGo!

items.title: Creative Strategist (AI-Native, Direct Response)
items.summary: Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

Outreach Hustle: Strong negotiation and persuasion skills to quickly secure high-converting partnerships on lean timelines. How to Apply Submit your resume along with 1–2 examples of previous campaigns where you directly drove sales or ticket conversions through grassroots outreach or creator partnerships. This is a remote position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/impulse-universe-inc-asian-american-expo-marketing-local-community-influencer-outreach

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . Veracode is seeking a Senior Website Manager to own the strategy, governance, performance, and ongoing evolution of Veracode.com. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions. You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. You will oversee site infrastructure, reusable templates, page builds, campaign support, content publishing, and continuous optimization for speed, security, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and user experience. The Senior Website Manager will improve the full digital journey, from organic discovery and campaign landing pages to content engagement, form conversion, personalization, and post-click experiences aligned to priority personas. This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots. Key Responsibilities Migration Ownership — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning. Day-to-Day Site Management — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency. Data and Analytics — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities. Content Governance and Quality Control — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain. Strategic Roadmap and Vision — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact. Design Strategy & Governance — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates. Conversion-First UX & AI-Enhanced Personalization — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels. Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy. Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance. Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities. SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences. Technical Oversight — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code. Website Release Management and QA — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring. Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time. Vendor and Agency Partnership — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently. Marketing Automation Integration — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce). This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance. Required Skills & Qualifications 8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth. Experience leading a full CMS migration for a large B2B site (hundreds of pages or more), including redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and tracking validation. Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM strategies, SEO and GEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), and CRO (A/B testing, heatmaps like Hotjar). Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL; frontend literacy (e.g., CSS Grid/Flexbox, animations). Familiarity with website security, ADA/WCAG compliance (accessibility-first design), performance optimization, and 2026 trends like AI personalization and immersive interactivity. Proven project management skills (e.g., Jira, Asana); experience managing agencies, vendors, in-house teams (development/design). Strong analytical mindset; ability to present performance, design, and growth reports to executives. Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration expertise. Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations. Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus. Examples of A/B Testing Strategies This Role Might Lead Headline/CTA variations on landing pages to boost conversions (e.g., testing benefit-focused vs. feature-focused copy). Layout changes (e.g., grid vs. organic/asymmetric) or visual elements (e.g., hero images/videos, micro-animations) for engagement/time-on-page. Form optimization (e.g., multi-step vs. single-page) or personalization (e.g., AI-segmented content) for lead capture. Button colors/sizes/text or navigation tweaks to improve click-through and funnel progression. Compensation Transparency: The total compensation package includes an anticipated base salary range of $125,000–$140,000, along with comprehensive benefits. The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting. Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-senior-website-manager
